title: Senior Client Servicing – Creative Presentations & Pitching
description:
**The Role**

You will be the hands-on creator of our presentations. You will turn briefs, strategy inputs and campaign ideas into visually striking, story-led decks for new-business pitches, proposals, credentials and client reviews, and then present them with confidence. You will work closely with strategy, creative, content and performance teams, and you will own the look, flow and message of every deck that leaves the agency.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and build creative, high-impact presentations from scratch (pitch decks, proposals, credentials, strategy and campaign decks, business reviews) in PowerPoint, Keynote, Google Slides or Canva or Similar.
* Turn briefs, RFPs and raw inputs into a clear storyline: opening hook, insight, big idea, solution, proof and a strong close.
* Create visually engaging slides with strong layouts, typography, colour, iconography, infographics and data visualization, aligned with each client's or the agency's brand.
* Collaborate with designers, copywriters and strategists to bring in visuals, mockups, case studies and campaign ideas, and give clear creative direction where needed.
* Lead new-business pitches and RFP/RFI responses end to end, coordinating inputs and deadlines across teams.
* Research prospects, categories, audiences and competitors across domains, and weave sharp insights into every deck.
* Present decks to clients and prospects, in person or on video calls, and handle questions and objections with confidence.
* Build and maintain a master library of editable templates, slide layouts, case studies, credentials and sector-wise content for fast, consistent decks.
* Create campaign performance reports and QBR/annual review decks that turn data into clear, visual stories.
* Track the pitch pipeline and win/loss outcomes, and use feedback to improve future decks.

**Requirements**

* 4–8 years of experience in client servicing, account management or business development at a digital marketing, advertising or media agency.
* A strong portfolio of creative presentations you have personally built, with proven pitch wins.
* Expert-level skills in PowerPoint and/or Keynote/Google Slides, plus Canva or Figma; a strong eye for layout, typography and visual hierarchy.
* Exceptional storytelling and copywriting ability in English, with the skill to simplify complex ideas into persuasive slides.
* Good understanding of digital marketing channels: social media, SEO, paid media, content, email and web.
* Ability to quickly research and understand new industries, audiences and competitors.
* Strong project management skills and comfort working to tight pitch deadlines with multiple teams.
* Confident presenter and communicator, able to handle client questions, negotiations and feedback.

**Good to Have**

* Basic design skills in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop or After Effects.
* Experience creating animated or interactive presentations (motion, transitions, embedded video, Prezi/Pitch).
* Experience with RFP-driven or tender-based pitches
* Experience building agency credentials, case studies and award entries.

description:

Estimation & Costing
  
  

* Prepare detailed cost estimates and budgets for EPC, Transmission, Distribution, District Cooling Systems (DCS), Substation, and other AESL projects.
* Analyze tender documents, scope of work, technical specifications, drawings, and commercial terms to develop accurate estimates.

* Conduct technical and commercial evaluation of vendor and subcontractor quotations.
* Identify cost optimization opportunities through value engineering and alternative solutions.
* Ensure proposed solutions meet technical specifications while remaining commercially competitive.

Cost Analysis & Risk Assessment
  
  

* Analyze market trends, material prices, labor costs, and subcontracting costs.
* Assess commercial, contractual, and execution risks associated with the bid.
* Prepare sensitivity analyses and identify risk mitigation measures.

* Engage with vendors, consultants, and customers for technical and commercial clarifications.
* Present estimation assumptions, costing methodologies, and commercial strategies to leadership teams.

Process Improvement & MIS
  
  

* Maintain cost databases, benchmarking records, and historical project cost data.

Master's Degree

* Supply Chain Optimization: Experience with analyzing and optimizing supply chain operations using SAP HANA, SCM, and SD tools, to improve efficiency and effectiveness.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Advanced SAP HANA Knowledge: Experience with advanced SAP HANA features and functionalities, including data modeling, data warehousing, and analytics. Ability to apply this knowledge to design and implement complex SAP HANA-based SCM and SD solutions.

Ability to apply this knowledge to help clients optimize their sales and distribution operations.

title: Key Account Manager - Quick Commerce & Marketplaces
description:
KEY ACCOUNT MANAGER - QUICK COMMERCE & MARKETPLACES

Company: Dronify Global Inc | Grabenord & Wyterra

Employment: Full-time

Workplace: On-site at our factory only

Location: Dronify Global Inc, Unit Nos. 22 & 23, Silver Industrial Estate, Sarkhej-Bavla Road, opposite HOF, Moraiya, Changodar, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 382213, India

Salary: Rs. 6,00,000 to Rs. 8,00,000 per annum

ABOUT US

Dronify Global Inc builds Grabenord, a plant-based gourmet food brand, and Wyterra, a dairy foods brand. Our portfolio includes cheeses, butters, dips, spreads and beverages. We are looking for a hands-on Key Account Manager to grow our quick-commerce and marketplace business through strong account management, reliable availability and profitable execution.

THE ROLE

Own account plans, platform relationships, assortment, demand planning, promotions and channel economics. Work closely with operations, finance and marketing support to improve consumer sell-through, contribution and collections.

This is a full-time, on-site position based exclusively at our Moraiya/Changodar factory. Candidates must be able to work from this location.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Manage and grow accounts across Swiggy Instamart, BigBasket, Blinkit, Zepto and selected marketplaces, as applicable.

• Build platform-city-SKU business plans and negotiate assortment, commercial terms, promotional support and launches within approved budgets.

• Maintain accurate listings, pricing, pack sizes, product information, images and brand mapping; coordinate content fixes with marketing support and specialists.

• Prepare demand forecasts and replenishment plans with operations; track purchase orders, warehouse receipts, availability, stock-outs and shelf life.

• Plan platform promotions and advertising with clear spending limits and contribution checks; distinguish platform-funded and brand-funded discounts.

• Track brand net revenue, consumer sell-through, margins, expiry losses, returns and channel inventory.

• Reconcile invoices, goods receipt notes, credit notes, deductions and settlements with finance; follow up on claims and overdue payments.

• Maintain a weekly account scorecard, rolling demand forecast and action log; present recommendations to the CEO.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• 3-6 years of relevant experience in food/FMCG sales, e-commerce or key account management, including at least 2 years of hands-on quick-commerce account ownership.

• Experience personally managing at least two major quick-commerce platforms, with a clear understanding of account operations and commercial terms.

• Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, negotiation ability and understanding of channel profitability.

• Ability to coordinate stock, shelf-life, dispatch and payment issues in a lean team.

• Ability to work full-time on-site at our Moraiya/Changodar factory.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

Chilled dairy, cheese, dips, beverages or other short-shelf-life foods; premium or emerging food brands; BigBasket and Amazon exposure; and familiarity with distributor-led supply. An MBA is useful, but demonstrated results matter more.

SUCCESS IN THE FIRST 90 DAYS

Establish a reliable account and contribution baseline, close priority listing and availability gaps, implement disciplined replenishment and reconciliations, and deliver the agreed profitable growth plan.

WHEN APPLYING

Please share your CV, the platforms and categories you have personally managed, and one anonymised example of improving sales, availability or contribution. Share only information you are entitled to disclose.

title: Area Manager Fluento
description:
**Role: AREA MANAGER FLUENTO**

**Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India**

**Fluento · AI-Powered English Speaking Programme**

**What is Fluento?**
Fluento is LEAD Group's breakthrough English Speaking Programme, powered by Miss Curie, a personalised AI Tutor. It adapts to each student's level, gives instant feedback as they speak, and builds real-world confidence through guided conversations. Built on two proven pedagogies: LRSI (Listen–Repeat–Speak–Interact) for conversation, and LRSP (Listen–Repeat–Speak–Present) for public speaking.

**Why join the Fluento team?**
Sell a product that genuinely transforms children's futures, backed by AI and proven pedagogy. Be part of LEAD Group, India's largest and fastest-growing School EdTech company. Reach 8,500+ schools, 60,000 teachers, and 3.8 million students across 400+ cities. Grow in a high-performance, mission-driven organisation with national scale

**About The Role:**
The Area Manager, Expansion is a hunter role at the heart of Lead Group's Fluento growth engine. You will be the primary revenue driver for new premium school acquisition within your territory, building and scaling both direct school relationships and distributor-routed channel partnerships. You will act as a strategic advisor to school principals and management committees, positioning Fluento's English-learning system as a transformational investment — not a commodity product. Success in this role requires the ability to open doors in premium institutions (where relationships and credibility matter), run disciplined multi-stakeholder sales cycles, and build a distributor network that multiplies your reach.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Premium School Acquisition (Primary — 60% of effort): Identify, prospect, and close new contracts with premium schools (annual fee ≥ ₹25,000); target 6-7 new school sign-ups per quarter through consultative, outcome-led conversations with principals, trustees, and academic heads.
* Distributor Channel Alignment (Secondary — 25% of effort): Onboard, and grow distributor partners across the territory; ensure ≥ 70% of registered distributors generate at least one order per quarter; drive ≥ 25% YoY distributor revenue growth.
* Pipeline Generation & Lead Management: Maintain a live pipeline of ≥ 2.5× monthly quota; generate 30–50 qualified leads per month from channel partners, referrals, and direct outreach; log all activities in CRM within 24 hours.
* Consultative Needs Diagnosis: Run structured discovery meetings to uncover each school's English-learning gaps, outcome objectives, and budget cycle; tailor Fluento's value proposition to each institution's specific context.
* Relationship & Retention Management: Ensure Year-1 schools transition into Year-2 renewals at ≥ 85% rate through proactive engagement, usage reviews, and outcome showcasing.
* Market Intelligence & Reporting: Provide weekly pipeline and territory health reports; flag competitive activity and pricing pressure; share school-level feedback to inform product and pricing strategy.

**Location & Travel**

* Base location: Designated city in assigned multi-city territory
* Travel: 80% field travel (4–5 days per week); inter-city travel as required for distributor and school coverage
* Coverage: 3–6 cities per territory depending on density and market maturity

**EXPERIENCE**

**Educational & Professional Experience:**

* Minimum experience: 3–6 years in B2B field sales with a quota-carrying role
* Education: Bachelor's degree (any discipline); MBA preferred but not mandatory
* Language: Fluency in English + local language(s) of assigned territory (mandatory for school conversations)
* Technical: Proficiency in CRM tools (Salesforce, Zoho, or HubSpot); working knowledge of MS Excel for pipeline tracking; ability to build and deliver slide-based presentations (PowerPoint / Google Slides)

**Must Have Criteries:**

* Consultative Selling Experience: Demonstrated track record of running needs-diagnosis-led sales conversations (not feature-pitch selling); ability to coach a school principal through problem articulation and ROI framing.
* Established Relationships with Premium Schools: Active, referenceable relationships with school decision-makers (principals, trustees, management committees) at institutions with annual programme fees of ₹25,000 or above.
* Distributor-Routed Business Experience: Proven experience building and managing distributor or channel partner networks; must be able to describe distributor onboarding, activation, and revenue management processes from personal experience.
* B2B Field Sales Experience: Minimum 3 years of end-to-end B2B field sales experience, preferably in EdTech, publishing, curriculum, or related education-adjacent sectors; track record of independently closing mid-size contracts.

**COMPETENCIES REQUIRED**

**Desired Skills:**

* Experience selling English-language, literacy, or supplementary curriculum products to K–12 institutions
* Knowledge of CBSE / ICSE / State Board school procurement and approval processes
* Prior experience managing a multi-city territory independently (without daily managerial oversight)
* Experience with schools transitioning from traditional text-book models to tech-integrated curriculum

**Personality & Behavioural Competencies**

* Hunter mindset with patience: Comfortable with long consultative cycles (30–45 days) while maintaining full pipeline discipline
* Challenger communicator: Able to reframe school concerns, handle objections without discounting, and anchor conversations on outcomes
* Organised self-starter: Plans weekly school visit schedules independently; prioritises high-potential accounts without prompting
* Relationship equity builder: Earns genuine trust from school stakeholders — not just transactional rapport
* Data-driven reporter: Updates CRM daily; pulls pipeline data to self-manage against quota

**Leadership Competencies**

* Ability to coach and support distributor partners through sales conversations
* Capacity to mentor junior sales staff once team expands
* Strategic thinking on territory market mapping, prioritises effort by revenue potential

description:

title: KAM
description:
**About Signify**
Through bold discovery and cutting-edge innovation, we lead an industry that is vital for the future of our planet: lighting. Through our leadership in connected lighting and the Internet of Things, we're breaking new ground in data analytics, AI, and smart solutions for homes, offices, cities, and beyond.
  
  
At Signify, you can shape tomorrow by building on our incredible 125+ year legacy while working toward even bolder sustainability goals. Our culture of continuous learning, creativity, and commitment to diversity and inclusion empowers you to grow your skills and career.
  
  
Join us, and together, we’ll transform our industry, making a lasting difference for brighter lives and a better world.
  
  
**Job Summary**
**More about the role**
This role is responsible for building and fostering relationships with selected Professional Trade key accounts to maximize profitability and customer satisfaction with these accounts. Develops strategic plans to achieve sales targets and expand business opportunities. Coordinates with internal teams to deliver solutions that meet client needs.
  
  
Key Areas of Responsibility
  
  

* Manages key professional trade accounts (electrical wholesalers, distributors, major installer networks, etc) and delivers sales targets, revenue growth, and profitability objectives within the assigned accounts or territory.
* Aligned to regional strategy, defines account strategies that drive profitable high-growth opportunities and customers’ engagement, that are documented in ¨Key Account Plans¨ (KAP’s)
* Has an in-depth understanding of the customer strategy and executes joint business plans with trade partners to grow sell-out, expand product listings, and increase market share.
* Analyzes market trends and customer needs to identify new business opportunities and optimizes assortment, pricing, and promotions.
* Works closely with installers and contractors to create demand and stimulate pull-through from trade partners.
* Drives continuous improvement initiatives by gathering client feedback and implementing efficiency solutions. Resolves issues promptly.
* Promotes the full Professional portfolio tailored to trade channel needs including LED lamps and luminaires and connected systems.
* Leads negotiations on terms, incentives, and trading conditions (commercial policy) to maximize profitability and maintain competitive positioning. Unlocks additional value within accounts by improving listings, securing frame agreements, and growing share of wallet within the distribution chain.
* Ensures accurate sales forecasting, pipeline management, and CRM reporting to enable business planning and transparency.
* Monitors execution quality across trade marketing, logistics, and aftersales processes to ensure operational excellence.
* Drives partner enablement through training on new products, connected solutions, and sustainability offerings.
* Continuously enhances own knowledge of company solutions, connected systems, and market developments through active participation in learning programs and sales capability initiatives.
* Leads account campaigns and promotions by aligning cross-functional teams (Sales Specialists, Channel Marketing, Product Marketing, Order Desk) to drive performance and meet customer expectations.
* Where applicable, drives online sales revenue growth for OTC portfolio by leading digital sales and optimizing customer engagement across online channels through the assigned accounts.
* Delivers monthly performance insights by analyzing sell-in/sell-out data and partnering with line manager and marketing to drive data-led decisions.

Critical Experiences
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Sales, Marketing, or a related field is essential to understand market dynamics and strategic account management. Background in lighting, electrical, or industrial goods sectors preferred.
* Minimum of 5 years of proven experience in key account management or sales roles within professional trade sectors, demonstrating success in strategic planning, customer relationship management, and cross-functional coordination. Familiarity with wholesale distribution channels and B2B sales dynamics, including online sales, in the electrical trade. Experience in negotiating rebates and campaign contracts, pricing, and service agreements.
* No specific licenses required; however, certifications in sales management or account management (e.g., Certified Professional Sales Leader) are advantageous but not mandatory.

**Everything we’ll do for you**
You can grow a lasting career here. We’ll encourage you, support you, and challenge you. We’ll help you learn and progress in a way that’s right for you, with coaching and mentoring along the way. We’ll listen to you too, because we see and value every one of our 27,000+ people. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace fosters creativity, innovation, and a full spectrum of bright ideas. With a global workforce present in 70+ countries, we are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where every voice is heard and valued, helping us all achieve more together.
  
  
Come join us, and together we can light up the future.

Job Title: Operations Executive

***About Role***

We are looking for motivated, compassionate and customer-focused Healthcare Sales & Client Intake Coordinator with a healthcare background who is comfortable speaking with people over the phone.

Your main responsibility will be to speak with families who contact the company for healthcare services, understand their requirements and help them book appointments with the right therapists.

* **CRM Management:**
  Update customer details, call records, follow-ups and lead status in the CRM.
* **Appointment Coordination:**
  Coordinate with customers and therapists to schedule and confirm appointments.
* **Process Improvement:**
  Manage follow-up reminders and suggest ways to improve the calling and booking process.
* **Marketing Support:**

* Educational background in healthcare, allied health, occupational therapy, psychology, speech therapy, nursing or a related field.
* Good spoken and written English communication skills.
* Confident in speaking over the phone with good listening and interpersonal skills.
* Patient, polite and comfortable interacting with patients and their families.
* Good organisational and time-management skills.
* Ability to handle multiple enquiries and regular follow-ups.
* Basic computer knowledge and willingness to learn CRM software.
* Experience in sales, telecalling, customer handling or appointment booking will be an added advantage.
* Knowledge of CRM tools like GoHighLevel, HubSpot or Zoho will be preferred.
* Basic marketing knowledge and experience working with Australian, UK or US clients will be an added advantage.

***Salary and Benefits***

* Fixed monthly salary plus performance-based incentives.
* Training on Australian healthcare services, NDIS and CRM software.
* Proper guidance and support to help you learn the role.
* Opportunity to work with an Australian company and international clients.
* Professional office environment.
* Career growth in sales, marketing and team management.
* Opportunity to work in the healthcare sector and help people.
* Accident Insurance
* Alternate Saturdays Off & Alternate Saturdays half day working

Join NSEG Private Limited and be a part of our dynamic team, contributing to the growth and success of our company.

**hr@nsegindia.com**

title: Business Manager
description:
Company Description

Rushika Capital is an RBI-registered and licensed Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC), focused on providing accessible and responsible financial solutions to individuals, entrepreneurs, and businesses.

With a commitment to customer-centric financial services, operational efficiency, and sustainable growth, Rushika Capital aims to build long-term relationships while delivering financial solutions that meet the evolving needs of its customers.

Role Description

We are seeking an experienced, dynamic, and result-oriented 
**Business Manager**
 with a strong understanding of the NBFC, banking, and financial services sector.

The role involves managing and developing business activities, identifying growth opportunities, overseeing operational performance, strengthening business relationships, and contributing to the organization's overall strategic objectives.

The ideal candidate should possess strong business acumen, leadership capabilities, and a comprehensive understanding of financial products, business operations, and the regulatory environment.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Business Development & Strategic Growth**

* Develop and execute strategies to drive business growth, revenue generation, and profitability.
* Identify new business opportunities, financial products, customer segments, and potential markets.
* Explore opportunities for business diversification, expansion, and strategic partnerships.
* Establish and monitor business targets, budgets, and performance indicators.

**2. Business Operations & Performance Management**

* Oversee and coordinate business activities to ensure smooth and efficient operations.
* Monitor business performance, operational productivity, and financial outcomes.
* Identify opportunities for process improvements, cost optimization, and enhanced service delivery.
* Ensure effective coordination among various business functions and departments.

**3. Financial Products & Portfolio Management**

* Manage and monitor performance across relevant financial products and business portfolios.
* Evaluate product performance, customer requirements, and market opportunities.
* Oversee relevant aspects of customer acquisition, servicing, portfolio quality, collections, and recovery management.
* Work closely with credit, risk, operations, and compliance teams to maintain sound business practices.

**4. Team Leadership & Management**

* Lead, guide, and coordinate teams to achieve organizational objectives.
* Establish clear performance expectations and monitor team productivity.
* Encourage accountability, collaboration, and professional development.
* Support resource planning and team development in line with business requirements.

**5. Partnerships & Stakeholder Management**

* Build and maintain relationships with customers, business associates, channel partners, and financial institutions.
* Identify and develop opportunities for strategic collaborations and distribution partnerships.
* Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure effective business execution.
* Represent the organization in relevant business discussions and professional engagements.

**6. Risk, Compliance & Reporting**

* Ensure business activities adhere to applicable RBI regulations, internal policies, and regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate with relevant departments to monitor operational risks, portfolio performance, and compliance.
* Prepare and review periodic business reports, financial performance indicators, and operational metrics.
* Provide recommendations and insights to management for improving overall business performance.

Qualifications & Experience

* Relevant managerial experience in an NBFC, bank, or financial services organization.
* Strong understanding of financial products, business operations, and the NBFC ecosystem.
* Proven experience in business development, strategic planning, and performance management.
* Knowledge of lending operations, portfolio management, risk management, and financial services distribution.
* Experience in team management, stakeholder relationships, and business expansion.
* Familiarity with applicable RBI regulations and compliance requirements.
* Strong analytical, negotiation, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to take independent ownership of responsibilities and deliver results.
* Bachelor's degree in commerce, finance, business administration, or a related field. An MBA or equivalent qualification is preferred.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a proactive, commercially driven professional with an entrepreneurial mindset and a hands-on approach to business management.

* The ideal candidate should demonstrate strong leadership, sound financial understanding, operational discipline, and the ability to identify opportunities, manage responsibilities independently, and contribute to the organization's long-term growth.

title: AI Strategy Consultant
description:
**About the E2M:**

E2M is a leading white-label growth partner for digital agencies worldwide, helping them scale through expert web development, digital marketing, and AI-powered solutions.

With 13+ years of experience, 350+ professionals, and 400+ agency partners globally, E2M offers services across WordPress, Shopify, SEO, PPC, content marketing, and AI automation.

Driven by an agency-first approach and our Black Label Standard, we work as an extension of our partners' teams, delivering quality, innovation, and reliable digital solutions that help them grow.

**Role Overview:**

* You will own AI engagements for our agency clients, from the first discovery call to live, adopted solutions. Our clients know AI matters but are held back by manual work, inconsistent AI output, and disconnected tools.
* You will find where time and money are being lost, define what to build and in what order, make sound architecture and security calls, and lead an engineering pod to ship production-ready systems. You are the person clients trust when things go right, and just as importantly, when they go wrong.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Discovery and Assessment**

* Run a structured 3 to 4 week AI assessment with stakeholders across PPC, SEO, content, project management, sales, and leadership.
* Use pre-call audit sheets to quantify manual work (task, frequency, hours) and steer toward the highest-value workflows.
* Map workflows end to end (tools, handoffs, data sources, failure points) and reframe solution-first requests into the real underlying problem.

**2. AI Blueprint and Proposal**

* Author the client AI Blueprint: 10 to 30+ use cases, each with current process, proposed solution and stack, dependencies, expected outcome, and timeline.
* Prioritise with an Impact vs. Effort matrix and recommend 2 to 3 high-impact starting automations.
* Design phased roadmaps (quick wins, leadership visibility, revenue and lead generation, then agentic systems) that build on existing tools.
* Present the plan to founders, covering team model, delivery cadence, testing approach (for example shadow mode), and pricing.

**3. Solution Architecture**

* Lead platform, hosting, and build vs. buy decisions with client technical teams (Azure AI Foundry, Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, multi-model).
* Define secure access: least privilege, read-only API scopes, SSO/SAML, RBAC, audit trails, and exclusion of sensitive data.
* Design knowledge systems: RAG pipelines, vector search trade-offs, tiered context management, MCP connectors, and reusable Claude Skills.
* Test feasibility on client APIs before scoping, manage cost-to-serve, and make deliberate "prototype now, re-architect later" calls.

**4. Delivery and Account Management**

* Run weekly syncs per account: demo progress, collect feedback, manage change requests, and reprioritise.
* Turn feedback into clear, testable requirements for the pod and hold the line on MVP dates.
* Own AI output quality: lead root cause analysis on failures, put safe interim processes in place, and track accuracy over time.
* Lead client communication on security incidents, covering impact, actions, and timelines.

**5. Adoption and Training**

* Train client teams through live sessions, SOPs, and follow-up coaching so solutions are used after launch.
* Ensure AI output matches each client’s brand voice and coach clients on giving feedback that improves it.

**6. Team Leadership**

* Direct the delivery pod: set requirements, review builds, and enforce a production-ready definition of done, edge cases included.
* Mentor junior team members toward client-facing roles through frameworks, scenario reviews, and call shadowing.

**Requirements:**

**1. Experience**

* 2+ years building custom AI solutions (LLM apps, RAG, agents, workflow automation) that reached production.
* 4+ years in client-facing delivery (Project or Program Manager, Solutions Consultant, CSM, or Account Manager), ideally in an agency or services company.
* Track record of owning multiple concurrent client engagements end to end.

**2. Technical Skills**

* **AI:**
  Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, prompt and context engineering, RAG, embeddings, vector search, output evaluation.
* **Build:**
  Python with FastAPI or LangGraph, MCP servers and connectors.
* **Integration:**
  APIs, webhooks, OAuth scopes, SSO/SAML, RBAC, secure credential handling, plus one cloud (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and Supabase or Postgres.
* **Agency stack:**
  GA4, Search Console, Google, Meta and Bing Ads, Klaviyo, SEO data providers, HubSpot, and PM tools (Teamwork, Basecamp, ClickUp, Monday, Productive).
* **Judgment:**
  Can sketch an architecture, estimate effort, and spot feasibility risks without an engineer in the room.

**3. Consulting Skills**

* Facilitates discovery workshops that surface the real problem.
* Quantifies ROI (hours saved, turnaround time, cost avoided) and uses it to prioritise.
* Writes clear proposals, Blueprints, requirements, and SOPs.
* Presents confidently to executives and discusses pricing, phasing, and scope in plain business language.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience productising a custom AI solution across multiple clients.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent delivery certification.
* Consulting background with exposure to process improvement and quality frameworks.
* Experience with AI search visibility, SEO intelligence, or marketing analytics.

description:
**General**

• Drive the ELV, IT, MEPF, Interiors, Medical Equipment consultants, OEMs and system integrators so their designs match the digital architecture.

• Ensure integration with the Hospital Information System (HIS), Integrated Building Management System (IBMS), ELV and security systems using open protocols and interoperable standards.

• Lead value engineering of technology selection, system convergence, quantities and phasing to optimise capital and lifecycle cost.

• Prepare specifications, BOQ inputs, RFPs and technical bid evaluations, and review consultant and vendor submissions.

• Support integration testing, commissioning and go-live readiness.

**1. Command Control Centre**

• Plan the centralised command centre for clinical, facility, security, emergency and fire and life safety (FLS) monitoring, including the video wall, dashboards, workstations and the room layout.

• Define the data feeds, alerts and response workflows from all integrated systems.

**2. Queuing System**

• Plan token and queue management for OPD, pharmacy, labs, imaging and billing, including displays, kiosks, SMS/app alerts and integration with the HIS.

**3. Population Counter System (for FLS and Pandemic Readiness)**

• Plan people-counting systems for real-time occupancy monitoring, crowd control, evacuation management and density control during pandemics.

• Integrate the system with the Command Centre, fire alarm and access control.

**4. Temperature Scanner (with Facial Recognition)**

• Plan thermal screening with facial recognition at entry points, integrated with access control, visitor management and alert systems.

• Ensure the data is handled in line with privacy requirements (DPDP Act).

**5. Registration & Visitor's Kiosk**

• Plan self-service kiosks for patient registration, appointments, payments and visitor passes, integrated with the HIS, the queuing system and access control.

**6. Radio Paging**

• Plan the radio paging and staff communication system for clinical, emergency and code alerts, with coverage across the campus.

**7. Dictation and Transcription**

• Plan digital dictation and speech-to-text transcription for clinicians, integrated with the EMR, the radiology information system and PACS (RIS/PACS), and reporting workflows.

**8. Point of Sales (POS)**

• Plan POS systems for the pharmacy, cafeterias, retail and billing counters, integrated with the HIS, the ERP and digital payment platforms.

**9. Hearing Enhancement System**

• Plan hearing loop / assistive listening systems at reception, counters, waiting areas, auditoria and lecture halls, in line with accessibility norms.

**General**

• Freeze the service requirements for each group in time for DD and GFC: power, data, water, drainage, medical gas, exhaust, structural loads and ceiling supports.

• Coordinate pre-installation needs, site readiness, delivery routes, installation, testing and commissioning.

• Plan the main and satellite pharmacies, including automated dispensing, unit-dose systems, compounding, chemotherapy reconstitution, cold-chain storage and controlled-drug storage.

• Integrate the pharmacy with the Hospital Information System (HIS), the pneumatic tube system and material flows.

• Define biosafety levels, biosafety cabinets, fume hoods, and the related utility, drainage and effluent requirements.

• Define the stations, zones, routes and capacity of the Pneumatic Tube System (PTS) for samples, blood and medicines.

• Ensure the centre complies with National Medical Commission (NMC) requirements.

We are looking for highly motivated and target-driven Admission Advisors (Builders) who can identify, qualify, and nurture prospective candidates before handing them over to the Senior Career Advisor (Closer) for enrollment discussions.
  
  
This role is a critical part of the sales process and requires individuals who can build trust, conduct meaningful discovery conversations, identify career challenges, create urgency, and schedule qualified candidates for detailed career consultations.
  
  
The Builder is not responsible for closing sales. Their primary responsibility is to generate qualified opportunities and ensure candidates attend their scheduled presentations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Lead Qualification & Discovery**

* Connect with prospective students and professionals generated through LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Instagram, referrals, inbound inquiries, and lead generation campaigns.
* Conduct structured discovery calls to understand the candidate's:

+ Current employment status
+ Visa status (OPT/STEM OPT/F1)
+ Job search stage
+ Target role and career goals
+ Current challenges and pain points
+ Interview readiness
+ Timeline and urgency

* Determine whether the candidate is qualified for ElevateMe's services.
* Categorize leads appropriately within the CRM.

**Need Identification & Need Generation**

* Identify gaps in the candidate's current job search strategy.
* Understand challenges related to:

+ Resume shortlisting
+ Lack of interview calls
+ Interview conversion issues
+ Communication challenges
+ Technical skill gaps
+ Career direction uncertainty

* Create awareness and urgency around the importance of structured career support.
* Position the value of the next consultation without using aggressive sales tactics.

**Presentation Booking**

* Schedule qualified candidates for detailed Career Trajectory Sessions with the Senior Career Advisor.
* Clearly communicate the purpose and value of the presentation.
* Confirm attendance and send reminders before scheduled meetings.
* Coordinate with Closers and Team Leads to ensure smooth handover.

**Presentation Attendance Management**

* Ensure candidates attend their scheduled presentations.

* Participate in critical presentations when required.
* Reschedule no-shows and maintain engagement until the candidate completes the presentation.

**CRM Management**

* Maintain accurate CRM records for every interaction.
* Update:

+ Call outcomes
+ Candidate notes
+ Follow-up schedules
+ Discovery findings
+ Lead stage progression

* Ensure 100% CRM compliance and data accuracy.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with:

+ Business Development Team
+ Lead Generation Team
+ Team Leads
+ Senior Career Advisors (Closers)

* Share market insights, candidate objections, and feedback to improve conversion rates.

**Daily Performance KPIs**

* 240 Outbound Calls per Day
* 180 Minutes Talk Time per Day
* Minimum 20–25 Meaningful Conversations per Day
* 100% CRM Update Compliance
* 95% Follow-Up Completion Rate

**Outcome Metrics**

* 4 Qualified Candidates per Day
* 4 Discovery Calls Completed per Day
* 4 Presentation Bookings per Day
* 60%+ Presentation Show-Up Rate
* Active Participation in Candidate Handover Process

**Monthly Performance KPIs**

* 80+ Qualified Opportunities Generated
* 80+ Presentation Bookings
* 60%+ Presentation Attendance Rate
* 20–25% Lead-to-Presentation Conversion
* 95% CRM Accuracy Score
* Consistent Follow-Up Compliance

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in any discipline.
* 1–5 years of experience in:

+ Inside Sales
+ Admission Counseling
+ EdTech Sales
+ B2C Sales
+ Telecalling
+ Lead Qualification
+ Career Counseling

Freshers with exceptional communication skills may also apply.
  
  
**Required Skills**
**Communication Skills**
Excellent verbal English communication with the ability to engage confidently with U.S.-based students and professionals.
  
  
**Discovery & Consultative Selling**
Ability to ask the right questions and uncover candidate needs.
  
  
**Active Listening**
Strong ability to understand candidate situations and build rapport.
  
  
**Objection Handling**
Ability to professionally handle concerns and resistance.
  
  
**CRM Proficiency**
Experience using CRM systems for lead tracking and sales management.
  
  
**Follow-Up Discipline**
Consistent and structured follow-up approach.
  
  
**Team Collaboration**
Ability to work effectively within a performance-driven sales environment.
  
  
**Ideal Candidate Profile**
**The Ideal Candidate**

* Is highly energetic and target-oriented.
* Can confidently engage with new prospects.
* Enjoys speaking with people and understanding their challenges.
* Has strong persuasion and relationship-building skills.
* Can create urgency without being pushy.
* Takes ownership of results and follows through consistently.
* Thrives in a fast-paced sales environment.

* Competitive Fixed Salary
* Attractive Performance Incentives

* Leadership Development Path
* Dynamic and Performance-Driven Culture

At ElevateMe, you will directly impact the careers of international students and professionals while building a rewarding career in sales and admissions. If you enjoy meaningful conversations, solving problems, and helping people move closer to their career goals, this role is for you.

Featured on Shark Tank India, the EleFant is expanding its presence across the country through a unique

We are looking for an ambitious Franchise Development Manager who can accelerate our expansion by bringing the right investors and business partners into the EleFant ecosystem.

The ideal candidate understands how to sell a business opportunity, not just a product.

**1. Franchise Sales & Revenue Ownership**

* Own monthly, quarterly and annual franchise acquisition targets.
* Generate and convert qualified franchise investor leads.
* Independently manage the entire franchise sales cycle from initial enquiry to agreement execution and payment collection.
* Present the EleFant's FICO model, business proposition, financial structure and commercial opportunity to prospective investors.
* Conduct investor meetings, online presentations and detailed commercial discussions.
* Handle objections related to investment structure, business performance, returns, operational responsibility and risk.
* Negotiate commercial terms within approved company guidelines.

* Generate opportunities through existing franchise-partner referrals.
* Work closely with Marketing to improve campaign quality, targeting and lead conversion.

* Conduct structured follow-ups and move prospects through the sales funnel.

title: Tender Executive
description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive
**Tender Executive**
to identify relevant government and private-sector tenders, prepare and submit bids, and manage e-procurement portals. The candidate will be responsible for tracking tender opportunities related to e-waste recycling, waste management, scrap disposal, EPR compliance, reverse logistics, and environmental services.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have prior experience in tender management, bid documentation, government procurement portals, and online tender submission processes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Tender Identification and Monitoring
* Regularly monitor government and public-sector tender portals, including GeM (Government e-Marketplace), CPPP, state e-procurement portals, and relevant private-sector platforms.
* Identify suitable tender opportunities related to e-waste collection, recycling, disposal, EPR compliance, scrap disposal, reverse logistics, and waste management.
* Evaluate tender eligibility, scope of work, submission deadlines, Earnest Money Deposit (EMD), tender fees, turnover requirements, experience criteria, and technical specifications.
* Maintain a structured tender tracker covering upcoming, active, submitted, and awarded tenders.
* Track tender amendments, corrigenda, pre-bid meetings, and deadline extensions.
* Tender Documentation and Bid Preparation
* Prepare and compile technical bids, financial bids, commercial proposals, and supporting documentation.
* Draft covering letters, declarations, undertakings, compliance statements, and other documents required by tendering authorities.
* Coordinate the collection and verification of company documents, including GST registration, PAN, CIN, audited financial statements, turnover certificates, work orders, experience certificates, and statutory records.
* Review tender conditions and ensure that all eligibility and documentation requirements are fulfilled before submission.
* Identify deviations, risks, missing documents, and compliance gaps, and escalate them to the concerned team before bid submission.
* Coordinate with internal departments to obtain technical, financial, and operational information required for preparing competitive bids.
* E-Procurement Portal Management
* Register and maintain company profiles on GeM, CPPP, state e-procurement portals, and other relevant procurement platforms.
* Manage Digital Signature Certificates (DSCs) and portal credentials securely.
* Upload tender documents, submit online bids, and complete all required e-procurement formalities within prescribed deadlines.
* Monitor portal notifications, technical clarifications, bid opening updates, and submission acknowledgements.
* Maintain organized records of tender documents, submission receipts, bid status, and related correspondence.
* Tender Pipeline and Reporting
* Maintain an updated database of tender opportunities, eligibility status, submission timelines, and outcomes.
* Prepare periodic reports on tenders identified, bids submitted, pending actions, and tenders awarded or rejected.
* Coordinate with management to prioritize suitable opportunities based on eligibility, commercial viability, and business requirements.
* Follow up on tender results, requests for clarification, technical evaluations, and financial bid openings.
* Maintain a systematic digital repository of tender-related documents for future reference.

**Required Qualifications And Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in tender management, bid coordination, or e-procurement operations.
* Practical knowledge of GeM, CPPP, and/or state government e-procurement portals.
* Experience in preparing technical bids, financial bids, compliance documents, and commercial proposals.
* Understanding of tender eligibility criteria, EMD, tender fees, turnover requirements, and bid submission procedures.
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel, MS Word, and document management.
* Strong attention to detail, documentation, coordination, and deadline management.
* Good written communication skills and the ability to coordinate with internal teams and external authorities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience handling tenders related to e-waste recycling, scrap disposal, waste management, environmental services, or reverse logistics.
* Familiarity with EPR compliance, CPCB requirements, and relevant waste management regulations.
* Experience with government departments, PSUs, municipal corporations, industrial organizations, or institutional procurement.
* Knowledge of DSC-based online bid submission and tender portal registrations.

Skills: e-procurement,government e-procurement portals,tender compliance,tender management,tender fee management,cppp,bid preparation,financial bids,gem,tender documentation

title: Key Account Manager
description:
Role Purpose

MachineAstro is looking for a commercially driven Key Account Manager responsible for growing strategic industrial accounts through customer value creation, new opportunity hunting, use-case development, account expansion and revenue growth. The role combines consultative selling with strong technical understanding of vibration monitoring, condition monitoring and asset health. The KAM will work across plant, corporate, technical, procurement and senior-management stakeholders and convert customer problems into measurable business outcomes and sustainable revenue.

 Key Responsibilities1. Strategic Key Account Ownership

·      Own assigned strategic accounts and prepare account plans covering customer priorities, installed base, stakeholders, whitespace, opportunities, risks and growth actions.

·      Build multi-level relationships across maintenance, reliability, engineering, operations, digital/IT, procurement and senior management.

·      Understand customer operations, asset criticality, maintenance practices and business priorities to identify areas where MachineAstro can create value.

2. Account Growth & Expansion

·      Drive year-on-year growth within existing accounts through cross-sell, upsell, additional assets, plants, business units, applications and services.

·      Identify whitespace and increase MachineAstro share of wallet by expanding successful deployments from machine/area level to line, plant, multi-site or enterprise programs.

·      Convert successful POCs, pilots and initial deployments into repeat and larger commercial programs.

3. Opportunity & Use-Case Hunting

·      Proactively identify new customer problems, reliability gaps and business cases rather than relying only on inbound enquiries or RFQs.

·      Identify opportunities related to recurring failures, unplanned downtime, maintenance cost, inspection effort, safety, critical rotating equipment and predictive-maintenance initiatives.

·      Develop new use cases and convert identified pain points into qualified opportunities with clear technical, commercial and value propositions.

·      Maintain strong focus on pipeline creation, opportunity quality and conversion.

4. Value Creation & Consultative Selling

·      Position MachineAstro as a reliability and technology partner, linking solutions to measurable customer outcomes.

·      Develop ROI/value cases around downtime avoidance, maintenance cost reduction, asset availability, reliability, safety and productivity.

·      Work with SMEs and presales to quantify value, develop solution proposals and demonstrate business impact.

·      Capture successful outcomes and replicate proven value propositions across similar accounts or plants.

5. Customer Engagement, POC & Solution Execution

·      Conduct regular customer plant visits, asset assessments, POC discussions, technical workshops, demonstrations, reviews and training.

·      Lead customer-facing POCs with clear objectives, success criteria, timelines and commercial conversion plans.

·      Coordinate project planning and delivery from the account perspective, ensuring commitments and customer expectations are met.

·      Identify expansion opportunities during and immediately after implementation.

6. Technical & Fault-Analysis Coordination

·      Understand vibration and condition-monitoring concepts and customer asset failure modes sufficiently to lead technical-commercial discussions.

·      Coordinate with CAT-II/CAT-III analysts and SMEs for asset fault analysis, recommendations and data-driven customer insights.

·      Translate technical findings into operational impact, business value and recommended next actions.

7. Customer Success & Retention

·      Ensure customers realize measurable value from deployed solutions and maintain high levels of adoption and satisfaction.

·      Identify risks to customer satisfaction, renewal, adoption or expansion and drive timely resolution with internal teams.

·      Convert customer success into references, case studies, repeat deployments and expansion opportunities.

8. Internal & Partner Collaboration

·      Align SMEs, presales, product management, inside sales, delivery and customer-success teams around account priorities and opportunity strategy.

·      Develop productive relationships with system integrators, consultants and technology partners to create and expand opportunities.

·      Share customer requirements, market feedback and competitive intelligence with relevant internal teams.

9. Commercial Management & Payment Follow-up

·      Own commercial follow-up for assigned accounts in coordination with finance, sales operations and business teams.

·      Track purchase orders, invoicing, payment milestones, outstanding receivables and agreed credit terms.

·      Proactively follow up with customer commercial/procurement/accounts-payable teams to ensure invoices are processed and payments are received on time.

·      Escalate overdue payments, disputes and commercial risks promptly and coordinate resolution with internal stakeholders.

·      Maintain healthy receivables and ensure account growth is supported by disciplined cash collection.

10. Market Intelligence & Marketing Support

·      Track industry trends, customer priorities, competitor positioning and emerging technologies in condition monitoring, predictive maintenance and Industrial IoT.

·      Identify market intelligence that can improve MachineAstro's value proposition and opportunity strategy.

·      Support marketing with customer insights, case studies, application stories, demos, blogs, videos and success stories.

11. Revenue & Management Reporting

·      Own account-level revenue growth in collaboration with Business Development and Sales leadership.

·      Maintain accurate pipeline, forecast, opportunity stages, closure plans and account-growth metrics.

·      Provide management updates on revenue, pipeline, new use cases, expansion opportunities, customer risks, collections and strategic actions.

   Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

·      Year-on-year revenue growth from assigned key accounts

·      New revenue generated from existing customers

·      Account expansion and share-of-wallet growth

·      New opportunities and qualified pipeline generated

·      New use cases / business cases developed

·      POC-to-commercial conversion rate

·      New plants, business units and assets penetrated

·      Customer retention, satisfaction and referenceability

·      Forecast accuracy and opportunity conversion

·      On-time collection / receivables performance and reduction of overdue payments

·      Strategic account-plan execution and stakeholder coverage

 Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hunter-farmer and trusted advisor who can protect and grow existing relationships while continuously discovering new customer problems, creating business value and converting opportunities into revenue. The candidate should be comfortable engaging with plant engineers as well as senior business leaders and should combine technical credibility with strong commercial ownership.

 Qualifications & Experience

·      BE / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering – preferred/required based on role fit

·      10+ years of relevant experience in industrial B2B sales, key account management, business development, reliability, condition monitoring, predictive maintenance, industrial automation or related fields

·      CAT-II / CAT-III Vibration Certification – strongly preferred

·      MBA in Marketing, Sales, Business Management or related discipline – preferred

·      Demonstrated experience managing strategic industrial accounts and delivering account growth

·      Experience with manufacturing/process industries and technical solution selling is highly desirable

 Core Competencies

·      Strategic Key Account Management

·      Account Expansion, Cross-sell & Upsell

·      Opportunity Hunting & Consultative Selling

·      Value Selling and Business Case Development

·      Vibration / Condition Monitoring Understanding

·      Customer & Executive Stakeholder Management

·      Commercial Negotiation and Collection Follow-up

·      Pipeline, Forecasting and Revenue Ownership

·      Problem Solving and Cross-functional Leadership

·      Strong communication, presentation and plant-level engagement skills

 Preferred Industry Exposure

Automotive & Auto Components • Steel & Metals • Cement • Power & Energy • Oil & Gas • Petrochemical • Chemicals • Pharmaceuticals • FMCG • Food Processing • Pulp & Paper • Mining • General Manufacturing • Process Industries • Industrial Automation / IIoT • Condition Monitoring / Predictive Maintenance

  Role Success Statement

* The core objective of the role is to grow strategic accounts by creating more value for customers. Success means deeper stakeholder relationships, more use cases, larger deployments, new plants and business units, stronger customer outcomes, healthy collections and sustainable year-on-year revenue growth.

title: Founder’s Office Intern
description:
GetNomik — Founder’s Office Intern

Department: Founder’s Office / Strategy & Operations

Reports to: Founder

Employment Type: Full Time internship

Company: GetNomik — LegalTech & Digital Solutions

Website: https://getnomik.com

1. Role Overview

The Founder’s Office Intern will work closely with GetNomik’s founding team to execute strategic initiatives, support business development, coordinate cross-functional teams, conduct market research, and improve operational efficiency.

The role offers exposure to startup strategy, product development, legal technology, marketing, partnerships, and business operations.

2. Key Roles & Responsibilities

A. Founder’s Office & Strategy

\* Support founders in executing company priorities, strategic projects, and growth initiatives.

\* Research new business opportunities, market trends, competitors, and potential revenue streams.

\* Prepare business reports, presentations, meeting briefs, and performance updates.

\* Track strategic goals, deadlines, and deliverables across teams.

\* Follow up with team members to ensure timely execution of assigned tasks.

B. Business Development & Partnerships

\* Identify potential lawyers, notaries, chartered accountants, law firms, and business partners.

\* Research and maintain a database of prospective clients and strategic partners.

\* Support outreach campaigns, introductory meetings, and partnership discussions.

\* Assist in developing proposals, pitch decks, partnership models, and sales materials.

\* Track leads, follow-ups, conversions, and partnership progress through the company CRM.

C. Product & Project Coordination

\* Coordinate with product, technology, design, and marketing teams.

\* Collect user feedback and identify opportunities to improve GetNomik’s products.

\* Track product launches, feature requests, bugs, and project milestones.

\* Assist with user testing, product documentation, and launch planning.

\* Help coordinate initiatives across GetNomik’s product ecosystem, including Nomiq, DigiLog, DigiVault, eNotarise, NomikPro, and LexNomik, as assigned.

D. Marketing & Growth

\* Support the planning and execution of marketing campaigns.

\* Coordinate content calendars, LinkedIn campaigns, newsletters, and promotional initiatives.

\* Conduct competitor benchmarking and customer research.

\* Help develop marketing briefs, campaign reports, and growth experiments.

\* Monitor agreed performance indicators, such as leads generated, engagement, registrations, and conversions.

E. Business Operations

\* Assist in developing internal processes, SOPs, checklists, and reporting systems.

\* Maintain project trackers, meeting notes, action items, and operational documentation.

\* Coordinate onboarding activities and follow up on internal administrative tasks.

\* Identify process bottlenecks and recommend practical improvements.

\* Support recruitment coordination, intern onboarding, and team communication where required.

F. Research & Business Intelligence

\* Conduct research into the Indian legal services and legal technology markets.

\* Analyse competitor pricing, positioning, product features, and customer acquisition strategies.

\* Prepare structured research reports and evidence-based recommendations.

\* Validate assumptions using reliable sources, customer feedback, and available business data.

3. Key Deliverables

The intern will be expected to contribute to measurable outcomes, including:

\* Weekly founder’s office progress reports.

\* Updated project trackers and action-item registers.

\* Qualified prospect and partnership databases.

\* Competitor research and market opportunity reports.

\* Product feedback summaries and project status updates.

\* Marketing and business development performance reports.

\* Documented operational improvements and completed strategic projects.

Specific targets will be agreed with the reporting founder based on the intern’s experience, available resources, and assigned projects.

4. Required Skills & Competencies

\* Strong written and verbal communication.

\* Research, analytical thinking, and problem-solving.

\* Organisation, time management, and attention to detail.

\* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.

\* Proficiency in Google Workspace or Microsoft Office.

\* Familiarity with spreadsheets, presentations, project trackers, and CRM tools.

\* Interest in startups, entrepreneurship, LegalTech, SaaS, or business strategy.

\* Professional handling of confidential business information.

5. Performance Evaluation

Performance will be assessed based on:

\* Quality and timely completion of assigned projects.

\* Reliability of reporting and follow-up.

\* Research accuracy and quality of recommendations.

\* Contribution to qualified leads, partnerships, and growth initiatives.

\* Effectiveness of project coordination.

\* Initiative, accountability, and communication.

\* Demonstrable improvements to business processes.

6. Professional Expectations

\* Maintain confidentiality regarding company information, customer data, and internal discussions.

\* Communicate progress, risks, and delays proactively.

\* Record tasks and project updates in the designated company systems.

\* Verify information before sharing research or business recommendations.

\* Obtain appropriate approval before making external commitments or representing company positions.

\* Follow company policies, applicable law, and agreed working arrangements.

7. Scope of Authority

The Founder’s Office Intern may research, coordinate, recommend, and execute approved tasks. The role does not independently authorise the intern to sign contracts, approve expenditure, make binding commitments, access restricted customer data, or make hiring and financial decisions on behalf of GetNomik.

title: Utilities Field Product Leader
description:
Founding Head — Utilities Field Product

**Build, roll out and grow OriginBluy's new field platform for gas utilities, from the first site to the next client.**

About OriginBluy

OriginBluy is building a new product: a field work platform that connects a city gas company's contractors, customer care and customers in one live job record. Contractors update each job on WhatsApp with photo proof. The status flows into the utility's SAP, and customers hear what is happening before they have to ask.

Our first deployment is a 90-day pilot with a leading Gujarat gas utility that completes about 38,500 new connections a quarter. You will be the person who makes that pilot work on the ground, and the template for every city we expand to after it.

The role

You own the success of a new product, end to end. First, you make our pilot with a leading Gujarat gas utility a clear success. Then you take that proof to other utilities and lead the sale. In the morning you may be on a site with a plumbing crew; in the afternoon, presenting results to an MD or pitching a new client.

This is a product-building role as much as an execution role. The platform is new, and contractors and their crews are the people who use it every day. You will help build it with them: what you observe and hear in the field decides what we build next.

You are the face of the product to contractors, to our first client's leadership and to every new utility we pursue. Contractors should trust you because you understand their work; senior leaders should trust you because you bring facts, not excuses. You report to the Founder and CEO and work as a partner in building the business.

**Title:**
 Founding Head – Utilities Field Product · 
**Type:**
 Contract to start then full time · 
**Base:**
 Ahmedabad or Gandhinagar

What you will do

**With contractors and crews**

* Onboard every contractor in the pilot area and get their crews updating jobs on WhatsApp with photo and GPS proof.
* Conduct field trainings for supervisors and plumbers, on site, in Gujarati or Hindi, and retrain crews where inspections fail.
* Demonstrate the product to contractors and their crews in 15 minutes, and get them using it the same day.
* Visit sites every week so contractors know the work is checked.
* Settle disputes between contractors, customers and the utility using the job evidence.
* Keep contractor capacity honest: jobs accepted only up to the number of certified crew available.

**With the utility's teams**

* Run a short daily review of the at-risk job list with the utility's area owner, and chase each delay until it is resolved.
* Work with care and service centre heads so their teams use the live job status in SAP.
* Present pilot progress to the MD and senior leadership: what moved, what is stuck, what you need from them.

**Building the product with OriginBluy**

* Shadow crews on real jobs and record structured observations: where time is lost, what confuses users, what workarounds they use.
* Turn those observations into clear product requirements with the product team.
* Test new features with contractors and crews before they are released, and bring back their feedback.
* Report what breaks in the field within days, with evidence.
* Track the pilot scorecard every week and own the numbers.
* Recruit and manage one or two field coordinators as the pilot scales.
* Document the playbook so the next city can be launched faster.

**Growing the business**

* Turn the pilot results into a clear, evidence-backed case for other gas utilities.
* Build a pipeline of target utilities, in Gujarat first and then other states.
* Run demos and discussions with MDs and heads of operations, projects and customer care.
* Shape proposals, pricing and pilot terms with the Founder.
* Lead new pilots and convert them into long-term contracts.
* Keep the first client a strong, willing reference.

Who you are

* **Mandatory: real, hands-on ground experience.**
   8–12 years doing field work yourself in city gas distribution, a utility, or an EPC or pipeline contractor, as a site engineer, site manager or operations manager. You have stood on sites, managed crews and contractors, and know how a PNG connection is built, from survey to gas-on. Desk-only or consulting backgrounds will not be considered.
* **Deep relationships across PSUs, government and utilities.**
   You have strong, active links with decision-makers in gas, power and other utility companies, PSUs and the government departments that oversee them, and you know how they evaluate, approve and buy.
* **Commercial instinct.**
   You have sold to, or won business from, utilities, PSUs or large industrial clients, or you are clearly ready to. You can open a door, run a meeting and follow through to a decision.
* **Equally at home on a site and in a boardroom.**
   You can win over a plumbing supervisor, and you can present calmly and crisply to an MD.
* **Fluent in Gujarati and Hindi,**
   with clear spoken and written English for leadership meetings and proposals.
* **A natural trainer and explainer.**
   You can take a non-technical crew through a new app and get them using it the same day.
* **A sharp observer.**
   You notice how work really gets done, and you can describe it clearly enough for a product team to act on.
* **Firm and fair with contractors.**
   You hold people to commitments without breaking the relationship.
* **Comfortable with data.**
   You live in dashboards and Excel, and you act on what the numbers show.
* **A builder.**
   You want to create something new, are comfortable with ambiguity, and own outcomes rather than tasks.
* **Graduate engineer**
   (mechanical, civil, chemical or petroleum preferred), or equivalent field experience.

Good to have

* Experience at a Gujarat city gas company, or with contractors who work for one.
* Experience with PSU and government procurement: tenders, empanelment and approval processes.
* Exposure to SAP in a utility (service orders, contractor billing or customer service).
* Experience rolling out a field app or digital process to a distributed, non-office workforce.
* Experience in a startup, or in a new-business role inside a larger company.
* A network of contractors, plumbers and site supervisors in Gujarat.

Location, pay and how to apply

* **Base:**
   Ahmedabad or Gandhinagar.
* **Travel:**
   frequent day trips to pilot sites and service centres in Gujarat (for example Surat and Bharuch), plus travel to other states for client meetings.
* **Ownership:**
   [ESOPs or equity, to be discussed].
* **Growth:**
   as the product scales, you build and lead the field and client team across utilities.

**To apply,**
 send your CV to Vivek.slaria@originbluy.com with a short note on one field rollout you led and one client you helped win: what was stuck, what you did, and what changed.
