title: Manager - Student Recruitment & Outreach
description:
**Company Description**
ECA Global is a leading private higher education group founded in Australia, with multiple higher education brands across Sydney, Brisbane, Melbourne, Perth, and Parramatta. The group has expanded internationally with new campuses in the UK and operational hubs in Europe, China, the Philippines, Brazil, Nepal, and India. Each year, ECA Global welcomes around 15,000 students from diverse backgrounds into its global network of campuses. The organization focuses on delivering high-quality education, international pathways, and student-centric support services. ECA Global offers a multicultural work environment and opportunities to engage with learners and partners worldwide.

Position Summary: The Manager – Student Recruitment will lead and execute student recruitment strategies to achieve enrolment targets, expand market presence, strengthen institutional partnerships, and improve student conversion rates. The role is responsible for driving recruitment operations, developing effective outreach initiatives, managing recruitment channels, and building strong relationships with schools, colleges, education agents, employers, and other institutional partners.

The successful candidate will combine strategic planning, commercial acumen, market intelligence, operational excellence, and people leadership to deliver sustainable student recruitment growth. The role will also work closely with academic teams, Admissions, Student Services, and other internal stakeholders to ensure a seamless prospective student journey from initial enquiry through enrolment and onboarding.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Recruitment Strategy, Market Development & Partnerships**

* Develop and implement comprehensive student recruitment strategies aligned with institutional enrolment targets and business growth objectives.
* Identify priority markets, student segments, recruitment channels, and opportunities for market expansion.
* Build and maintain strategic partnerships with schools, colleges, education agents, employers, academic institutions, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Develop articulation agreements, feeder relationships, and student progression pathways to strengthen recruitment pipelines and improve conversion.
* Collaborate with academic teams to align recruitment campaigns, messaging, and market positioning with programme offerings and institutional priorities.
* Lead relationship development and stakeholder engagement across key domestic and international markets.
* Leverage market research, CRM insights, competitor analysis, and enrolment trends to inform recruitment strategies and identify new growth opportunities.
* Represent the institution at recruitment fairs, school visits, industry events, partner meetings, presentations, and other outreach activities.
* Identify and develop innovative recruitment channels, partnership models, and market penetration initiatives.
* Monitor the effectiveness of recruitment partnerships and implement strategies to improve partner engagement and performance.

**2. Recruitment Operations, Student Conversion & Performance Management**

* Manage the end-to-end student recruitment pipeline, from enquiry generation and application follow-up through offer acceptance, enrolment, and onboarding.
* Drive timely, accurate, and high-quality communication with prospective students, applicants, and recruitment partners.
* Monitor recruitment funnel performance and implement initiatives to improve enquiry-to-application, application-to-offer, and offer-to-enrolment conversion rates.
* Plan, coordinate, and oversee recruitment campaigns, marketing communications, outreach activities, open days, education fairs, and student engagement events.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), recruitment targets, pipeline metrics, and channel performance.
* Analyse recruitment data, identify conversion bottlenecks, and recommend corrective actions to improve enrolment outcomes.
* Prepare regular performance reports, market insights, pipeline updates, and strategic recommendations for senior management.
* Manage education agent performance, evaluate channel effectiveness, and implement appropriate performance improvement measures.
* Work closely with Admissions, Student Services, Marketing, and academic teams to ensure efficient application processing and a seamless student experience.
* Establish and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), process documentation, reporting frameworks, and quality assurance practices.
* Coordinate recruitment calendars, campaign timelines, event logistics, and competing operational priorities to ensure timely execution.
* Ensure recruitment activities deliver against agreed enrolment targets, service standards, and institutional growth objectives.

**3. Leadership, Team Management & Capability Development**

* Lead, motivate, and manage recruitment and outreach teams, where applicable, to achieve individual and collective performance targets.
* Set clear objectives, allocate responsibilities, monitor performance, and provide regular coaching and feedback.
* Build a high-performing, accountable, student-focused, and commercially driven recruitment culture.
* Develop team capabilities through training, mentoring, knowledge sharing, and continuous professional development.
* Foster collaboration across recruitment, marketing, admissions, academic, and student support functions.
* Introduce innovative recruitment approaches, student engagement initiatives, and outreach models to enhance productivity and market penetration.
* Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, improve operational efficiency, and strengthen recruitment processes.
* Oversee recruitment-related budgets, campaign expenditure, event planning, and resource allocation, as applicable.
* Promote data-driven decision-making, continuous improvement, and accountability for recruitment outcomes.
* Support succession planning, capability development, and the effective use of team resources to meet evolving business needs.

**4. Compliance, Governance & Stakeholder Management**

* Ensure recruitment practices comply with institutional policies, applicable regulatory requirements, and relevant quality assurance standards.
* Uphold equal opportunity, workplace health and safety (OSH), data privacy, and information security requirements.
* Ensure appropriate handling of prospective student and applicant information in accordance with applicable data protection requirements, including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA), where applicable.
* Maintain accurate recruitment records, partner documentation, performance reports, and operational records.
* Promote ethical recruitment practices, transparent communication, and a positive student experience throughout the recruitment journey.
* Build and maintain effective working relationships with internal teams, external partners, and senior stakeholders.
* Escalate recruitment risks, operational challenges, compliance concerns, and performance gaps in a timely manner.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be assessed against agreed institutional and departmental objectives, including:

* Achievement of student enrolment targets by programme, market, and recruitment channel.
* Improvement in enquiry-to-application and application-to-enrolment conversion rates.
* Growth in qualified student enquiries and recruitment pipeline volume.
* Effectiveness and productivity of education agents and institutional partnerships.
* Delivery and performance of recruitment campaigns, outreach activities, and events.
* Timeliness and quality of applicant communication and follow-up.
* Accuracy of recruitment data, reporting, and pipeline forecasting.
* Compliance with institutional policies, recruitment processes, and applicable regulations.
* Team productivity, target achievement, and professional development.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Education, International Relations, or a related discipline. A postgraduate qualification or relevant professional certification will be an advantage.
* Significant experience in student recruitment, education management, business development, institutional partnerships, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience in developing and executing recruitment strategies and achieving measurable enrolment or business growth targets.
* Proven experience managing recruitment pipelines, conversion processes, performance metrics, and stakeholder relationships.
* Experience developing and managing relationships with schools, colleges, education agents, employers, or institutional partners.
* Previous experience leading or supervising teams, setting performance targets, and driving accountability will be highly desirable.
* Experience in higher education, international education, or a multi-campus education environment will be an advantage.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* **Strategic thinking:**
  Ability to translate institutional growth objectives into practical recruitment strategies and actionable plans.
* **Business development:**
  Strong partnership-building, networking, negotiation, and market expansion capabilities.
* **Performance management:**
  Ability to establish KPIs, analyse recruitment data, identify trends, and drive measurable improvements.
* **Communication and presentation:**
  Excellent written and verbal communication, public speaking, and stakeholder engagement skills.
* **Leadership:**
  Ability to motivate teams, manage performance, develop talent, and foster a results-oriented culture.
* **Operational management:**
  Strong planning, organisational, prioritisation, budgeting, and execution capabilities.
* **Analytical ability:**
  Proficiency in interpreting market intelligence, CRM data, conversion metrics, and performance reports.
* **Relationship management:**
  Ability to establish and maintain productive relationships with diverse internal and external stakeholders.

title: Oracle Fusion Financial Consultant
description:
**About the Company**

Medovate Pvt Ltd is building a Technology and Operations Centre in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, to deliver Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials services for a multi-entity international group operating across the United States, United Kingdom, Mexico, China, and India. The group runs Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP across multiple legal entities and ledgers, with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) connecting Fusion Financials to banking partners, intercompany systems, and external platforms.

**About the Role**

We are seeking an Oracle Fusion Finance Functional Consultant to strengthen the Finance practice at Medovate's Ahmedabad center. This is a hands-on functional delivery role. You will support the configuration and delivery of Oracle Fusion Financials across General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash Management, Tax, and Fixed Assets, working under the direction of the Finance Functional Lead and alongside senior consultants. You will contribute to design workshops, execute configuration, prepare functional documentation, and support testing across a multi-entity international environment. This is an opportunity to broaden your Oracle Fusion Financials experience across multiple modules and geographies while building depth in a specialist Finance capability.

**Responsibilities**

**Solution Design and Configuration**

* Participate in discovery workshops and requirements-gathering sessions with Finance business stakeholders across multiple legal entities and geographies.
* Contribute to the functional design of Oracle Fusion Financials, including Chart of Accounts structure, ledger setup, SLA accounting rules, tax determination, and period-close processes.
* Prepare functional specifications, configuration workbooks, and gap-fit analyses under the guidance of the Finance Functional Lead.
* Perform configuration across GL, AP, AR, Cash Management, Tax, and Fixed Assets in line with agreed design decisions and Oracle best-practice standards.
* Support the setup of intercompany accounting, netting arrangements, and consolidation hierarchies for a multi-entity international group structure.

**General Ledger (GL)**

* Support Chart of Accounts configuration across multiple legal entities covering US, UK, Mexico, China, and India reporting requirements.
* Configure ledgers, accounting calendars, currencies, and intercompany balancing rules under direction.
* Assist with configuration and validation of Subledger Accounting (SLA) rules to ensure accurate accounting distributions from subledgers into the GL.
* Support period-end close activities including subledger close, revaluation, translation, and intercompany elimination runs.

**Accounts Payable (AP)**

* Configure AP functionality covering invoice management, three-way PO matching, payment processing, supplier setup, and BPM approval workflows.
* Configure and test multi-country electronic payment formats (SEPA, BACS, SWIFT, ACH, NEFT/RTGS) and payment process profiles aligned to each entity's banking arrangements.
* Support AP-to-GL accounting configuration including liability accounts, prepayments, withholding tax, and intercompany payables.

**Accounts Receivable (AR)**

* Configure AR functionality covering customer billing, AutoInvoice rule setup, multi-currency receipts, lockbox processing, and deductions management.
* Support the configuration of receipt application rules, aging bucket setups, and bad debt provisioning.
* Support AR-to-GL accounting distributions including revenue recognition and intercompany receivables setups.

**Cash Management**

* Support bank account structure setup and bank statement reconciliation configuration across group entities and banking relationships.
* Configure automated reconciliation rules, tolerance thresholds, and exception handling for multi-currency bank statement matching.
* Support testing of OIC-delivered bank interface integrations, including statement import formats, reconciliation mapping, and error handling.

**Tax, Oracle Tax**

* Configure Oracle Fusion Tax across applicable regimes including GST (India), VAT (UK), IVA (Mexico), US Sales Tax, and China VAT/Fapiao, under the direction of the Finance Functional Lead.
* Support the setup of tax determination rules, tax condition sets, and tax registration configurations, including scenarios such as intercompany transactions, imports and exports, reverse charge, and withholding tax.
* Support indirect tax compliance activities and help ensure Oracle tax outputs meet local statutory reporting requirements.

**Fixed Assets (FA)**

* Configure Fixed Assets functionality including corporate and tax asset books, depreciation methods, prorate conventions, and mass addition rules.
* Support CIP-to-asset capitalization workflows, asset retirement processes, and revaluation setups across operating jurisdictions.
* Support FA period-end close activities including depreciation runs and FA-to-GL reconciliation.

**Delivery and Collaboration**

* Work with Finance business users to clarify requirements and resolve day-to-day functional queries.
* Contribute to the Finance workstream across project phases: Discover, Design, Build, Test, and Deploy, ensuring assigned deliverables are completed on time and to quality.
* Prepare test scripts, execute SIT and UAT cycles, and log and track defects to closure.
* Collaborate with Oracle Fusion technical teams on RICEW deliverables, providing functional input on Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Extensions, and Workflows.
* Support OIC integration testing connecting Oracle Fusion Financials to banking, intercompany, and external systems.
* Continuously build product knowledge across Oracle Fusion Financials modules and work towards relevant Oracle certifications.

**Qualifications and Skills**

***Required***

* 3 or more years of hands-on Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials functional experience, including at least one full-cycle implementation or a major rollout, upgrade, or support engagement.
* Practical configuration experience across at least three of the core modules: General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash Management, Tax, and Fixed Assets.
* Working knowledge of core Financials concepts including Chart of Accounts structures, ledger and accounting calendar setup, and Subledger Accounting (SLA).
* Experience preparing functional documentation such as configuration workbooks, functional specifications, and test scripts.
* Experience executing SIT and UAT cycles, logging defects, and tracking them to closure.
* Understanding of the period-end close process across subledgers and GL.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work directly with Finance business users to clarify requirements.
* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field.

***Preferred***

* Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials certification in one or more modules.
* Exposure to multi-entity, multi-currency, or multi-ledger environments.
* Experience with Oracle Tax configuration for one or more of GST (India), VAT (UK), IVA (Mexico), US Sales Tax, or China VAT.
* Familiarity with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) delivered interfaces, particularly bank and intercompany integrations, from a functional testing perspective.
* Working knowledge of BPM approval workflow configuration.
* Exposure to RICEW deliverables and collaboration with technical teams.
* A professional accounting qualification (CA, CMA, ACCA, CPA, or part-qualified) is an advantage.

• Follow up on commitments and keep progress, pending actions and open issues visible.

• Check completed work against its original requirements.

• Prepare short progress summaries and flag decisions that need leadership attention.

You are expected to understand the work you coordinate. Collecting updates or maintaining a tracker without understanding the problem is not enough.

Product and technical-business work

• Use SVECTOR's software products to understand their real capabilities and limits.

• Understand customer workflows and the problems customers expect the product to solve.

• Investigate reported issues and tell defects apart from unclear requirements and new feature requests.

• Turn business and customer needs into clear problem statements, requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.

• Work with engineers to understand constraints, dependencies and possible approaches.

• Support demos, testing, customer pilots and implementation, and confirm delivered work meets the requirement.

You are not being hired as a full-time software developer, but strong technical literacy matters. You should be comfortable with concepts such as APIs, databases, integrations and data flows, and willing to learn what you do not yet know.

Research and analysis

• Research companies, industries, technologies and business opportunities.

• Compare competitors, products, technical approaches and tools.

• Study enterprise customers and the environments they operate in.

• Review reports, specifications and original source material.

• Prepare decision briefs and recommendations that state what is known, what the evidence is, what remains uncertain and what to do next.

We expect you to go beyond the first search result, verify important claims, check numbers and explain your reasoning. We value independent thinking over long documents full of generic observations.

Business and customer initiatives

• Research prospective customers and decision-makers, and prepare background for key discussions.

• Support demos, discovery calls and technical-business presentations.

• Turn customer feedback into specific product or business actions.

• Help with proposals and solution briefs, and coordinate pilot follow-ups.

• Join customer meetings and speak with external stakeholders when authorized.

There is no individual sales quota. Pricing, contracts and financial commitments stay subject to leadership approval.

Leadership support and AI tools

• Prepare briefing notes and short memos for important discussions.

• Record decisions, commitments and open questions, and keep actions tied to owners.

• Use AI tools and modern software for research, document analysis and repetitive workflows, and check their output against reliable sources.

Using AI does not remove your responsibility to understand your own work. An unverified AI-generated document that you cannot explain is not an acceptable deliverable. You will also follow company rules on confidential information and data handling.

Who You Are

• Curious: you want to understand a hard problem, not avoid it.

• Accountable: a task is done when there is an outcome, not when you have sent a message. You are honest about obstacles and mistakes.

• Structured: you break problems down, test assumptions and reach reasoned conclusions, even under uncertainty.

• Clear communicator: excellent written and spoken English, with precise emails, briefs and summaries.

• Technically curious: you enjoy learning how software is built and used. Coding experience helps but is not required.

• Reliable: you respect deadlines and confidentiality, know when you need approval, and accept feedback well.

Qualifications

• 0–4 years of relevant experience. Internships, independent projects, research, entrepreneurship or full-time work all count.

• A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, AI, Data Science, Business Analytics, Economics, Management or a related field is preferred. Other backgrounds are considered where projects show the capability. No MBA required.

• Experience in product operations, business analysis, technical consulting, software development, strategic research or project execution is relevant.

We care about work you have actually completed: a product or technical project, an internship where you solved a real problem, a research assignment with a defensible conclusion, or an initiative where you took responsibility beyond your assigned work. Tell us your own contribution, the decisions you made and the results.

This role is not an administrative or personal-assistant job, a software engineering job focused on production code, a pure consulting role or a senior management position. It is an execution-oriented role centered on product understanding, research, problem-solving and completing assigned initiatives.

What Success Looks Like

• First 30 days: learn the products, workflows and priorities, and complete initial research and product assignments accurately.

• Days 31–60: own a defined initiative, prepare an execution approach and keep progress visible.

• Days 61–90: carry an initiative to an agreed result or a documented handover.

Hiring Process

1. Application review

2. Initial discussion

3. Practical assessment: a realistic research, product or business task. AI tools may be used where permitted, but you must be able to explain and verify your work.

4. Leadership interview

5. Offer discussion: responsibilities, compensation, schedule and joining date are confirmed before a written offer.

Working Arrangements

Full-time, on-site in Ahmedabad, Monday to Saturday. Schedule, compensation and joining terms are confirmed before a formal offer. If anything about the role or location does not match your expectations, please raise it in the first discussion.

How to Apply

Send your resume with a short note covering:

1. Your strongest example of ownership: what you did, which decisions you made and what happened.

2. Why you are interested in technology, research, product understanding and business execution.

3. Your current location, availability to work full-time on-site in Ahmedabad and earliest joining date.

Links to projects, GitHub, portfolios or research are welcome. Please skip the generic statements.

title: Senior Application Associate, Financial Modeling
description:
**About The Role**

08
  
  
**The Team**
The Financial Modeling Group provides expert services for our most sophisticated analytical tools so that we can provide clients with a tailored experience when using our products. This global, seasoned team specializes in onboarding and client adoption for our Excel add-ins, Office Tools products, Screening and Platform customization, and Proprietary Data capabilities. The Financial Modeling Group is one of the primary touchpoints for our clients, and you will be the face of the organization. Your regular day would require you to build models, screens, presentations, answer client queries and be an advocate of our products while showcasing your vast knowledge of our tools and data. * Strong team player with excellent people skills. Ability to build good relationships at all levels, locally as well as globally.

title: Senior Implementation Consultant – EHR / EMR / HIS
description:
📍 India | UK business hours

🧠 Typically 3–8 years’ relevant experience

📅 Notice periods up to 45 days welcome

🚀 Bring your EHR expertise to the next generation of private healthcare

You know how healthcare software works. You can understand a customer’s workflows, design the right configuration, explain the product confidently and take an implementation through to go-live.

Now imagine owning that entire journey—and remaining the person the customer trusts as their business grows.

Script Assist is hiring a
**Senior Implementation Consultant**
with experience implementing, configuring and optimising Electronic Health Record (EHR), Electronic Medical Record (EMR), Electronic Patient Record (EPR) or Hospital Information System (HIS / HMIS) platforms.

We are particularly interested in professionals with experience across Oracle Health / Cerner, eClinicalWorks, Altera / Allscripts, Epic, NextGen Healthcare, InterSystems TrakCare, MEDITECH, athenahealth, Dedalus or comparable healthcare software.

You may currently work at an EHR vendor, a healthcare technology company, or within the healthcare technology consulting teams of PwC, Deloitte, EY, KPMG, Accenture, Cognizant, Infosys, TCS, Wipro, HCLTech or CitiusTech.

If you built your product expertise at an EHR vendor and subsequently moved into healthcare technology consulting, we would particularly like to hear from you.

**🏥 About Script Assist**

Script Assist is building the technology and operating infrastructure behind next-generation private healthcare in the UK.

Our platform already supports tens of thousands of prescriptions every month, with established scale in medical cannabis and expansion into ADHD, weight management, longevity and specialist private medicine.

We bring together the workflows that clinics, pharmacies and healthcare operators need to run their services:

• Patient onboarding and patient portals

• Clinical consultations and scheduling

• Prescribing and repeat prescriptions

• Pharmacy, dispensing and inventory

• Payments and operational workflows

• Patient communications, reporting and integrations

Every customer operates differently. Your role is to understand those differences, design the right solution and help each customer get the best from Script Assist.

You will work directly with UK healthcare customers and closely with our leadership, Product and Engineering teams—with real influence over customer delivery and product development.

**🎯 The opportunity**

You will become a product expert and trusted client lead for UK clinics, pharmacies and healthcare operators.

You will understand their operations, design their workflows, configure their solution, demonstrate the product, train their teams and guide them through implementation.

After go-live, you will retain ownership of the relationship, helping customers resolve problems, improve adoption and develop how they use the platform.

The role brings together:

• EHR implementation and functional consulting

• Clinical and operational workflow design

• Application configuration and solution design

• Client workshops, product demonstrations and training

• UAT, go-live and post-implementation optimisation

• Ongoing client ownership and stakeholder management

**⚙️ What you will own**

Workflow discovery and functional solution design

• Lead client discovery sessions and requirements workshops.

• Map clinical and operational processes into clear system workflows.

• Translate requirements into configuration decisions, functional specifications and acceptance criteria.

• Advise customers on how to use the product effectively.

• Identify dependencies, explain trade-offs and challenge requirements constructively.

EHR application configuration

• Configure or lead the configuration of modules, forms, clinical templates, user roles, permissions, rules and system settings.

• Understand how configuration decisions affect the wider patient, clinician and pharmacy journey.

• Work across registration, appointments, clinical documentation, prescribing, medication management, work queues, patient portals and payments.

• Identify which requirements can be met through configuration and which need integration or product development.

Implementation and go-live

• Own customer delivery from discovery and solution design through configuration, testing, training and go-live.

• Coordinate data migration, integrations and customer dependencies with specialist teams.

• Lead UAT preparation, issue resolution and go-live readiness.

• Deliver product demonstrations, workflow walkthroughs and user training.

• Manage hypercare and the transition into ongoing platform use.

Client consulting and relationship ownership

• Lead meetings with clinicians, operational managers and senior healthcare stakeholders.

• Explain system behaviour and recommendations clearly and confidently.

• Manage expectations, priorities, actions and escalations.

• Maintain a detailed understanding of each customer’s workflows, configuration and objectives.

• Build lasting relationships through product knowledge, sound judgement and reliable follow-through.

Post-implementation optimisation

• Remain directly involved after go-live.

• Improve adoption, workflows, configuration and user confidence.

• Diagnose issues involving permissions, data, configuration, training, integrations or software behaviour.

• Translate product gaps into clear requirements for Product and Engineering.

• Validate fixes and follow issues through to resolution.

**✅ The experience we are looking for**

• Typically 3–8 years of relevant EHR, EMR, EPR, HIS or clinical information systems experience. Strong candidates outside this range are welcome.

• Deep functional knowledge of at least one substantial healthcare software platform.

• Personal involvement in system configuration or detailed configuration design.

• Experience delivering implementations or substantial optimisation projects for external healthcare customers.

• Direct responsibility for client workshops, requirements discussions, training or implementation decisions.

• Confidence investigating application and workflow problems.

• Experience collaborating with Product, Engineering, QA and Support.

• Excellent spoken and written English, with the ability to independently lead senior UK client conversations.

• A hands-on approach and enthusiasm for learning a complex healthcare product.

**🔎 Relevant platforms and backgrounds**

We welcome experience with:

• Oracle Health / Cerner Millennium

• eClinicalWorks / eCW

• Altera Digital Health / Allscripts, including Sunrise and TouchWorks

• Veradigm

• Epic

• NextGen Healthcare / NextGen Enterprise

• InterSystems TrakCare

• MEDITECH / Expanse

• athenahealth / athenaOne

• Dedalus

• PracticeSuite, MicroMD, Napier, Ohum and other substantial EHR / EMR / HIS platforms

Relevant functional experience may include ambulatory care, outpatient workflows, patient administration, scheduling, clinical documentation, electronic prescribing, medication management, pharmacy, patient engagement and practice management.

Experience working with US, UK or other international healthcare customers is particularly valuable.

Relevant current or previous roles

Your title may be:

• Implementation Consultant / Senior Implementation Consultant

• Functional Consultant / Senior Functional Consultant

• Clinical Consultant / Clinical Applications Consultant

• Application Consultant / Application Specialist

• Delivery Consultant / Senior Associate Delivery Consultant

• EMR Consultant / EHR Consultant

• Clinical Information System Consultant

• Implementation Project Manager / EMR Project Manager

• Post Implementation Project Manager

• Implementation Manager / Client Onboarding Manager

• Product Specialist / Solution Consultant

• Healthcare Technology Consultant / Senior Associate

Candidates in EHR product ownership, business analysis or strategic client delivery are also welcome where their experience includes substantial configuration knowledge and personal implementation responsibility.

**🌟 Why join Script Assist?**

• Own the customer journey from initial requirements to long-term platform success.

• Apply your EHR expertise across a growing range of private healthcare services.

• Work directly with UK healthcare customers and senior decision-makers.

• Stay close to the product, with direct access to Product, Engineering and leadership.

• See your recommendations become working solutions used by real healthcare teams.

• Help shape both customer delivery and the platform itself.

**📍 Location, working hours and joining**

• Based in India.

• Available Monday–Friday, 09:00–18:00 UK time, including a one-hour break.

• UK summer hours: 13:30–22:30 IST.

• UK winter hours: 14:30–23:30 IST.

• Candidates able to join within 45 days are welcome.

**Interested?**

title: Customer Relationship Management Consultant
description:
Customer Care Transformation Consultant

**Engagement:**
 Monthly contract. Full-time on the client through diagnostics, then a delivery role as the program moves into training and monitoring.

About the role
  

OriginBluy is running a Customer Care Gold Standard program for a large utility that serves more than 23 lakh households through 60+ walk-in service centres and an inbound call centre.

The consultant is our person on the ground: they diagnose how service works today, help define the Gold Standard, and stay through training and monitoring until the client’s own managers can hold the standard.

They report to the Principal Coach and work directly with the client’s customer care leadership, centre managers and call centre teams.

What you’ll do

**Diagnose**

* Run mystery shopping at walk-in centres: brief and calibrate the shoppers, score visits and consolidate the findings
* Select and listen to recorded calls with a focus on outliers (best, worst, repeat and escalated calls) and find the root cause of each: behaviour, process, system or policy
* Interview centre managers, call centre team leads and functional heads
* Pull together existing SOPs, scripts, QA formats and MIS into one baseline

**Define**

* Map the end-to-end customer journey for the top contact reasons, both walk-in and call
* Draft the Gold Standard: interaction standards, scripts, SOPs, escalation paths and the scorecard
* Build the cost-benefit case with client Finance: contact volumes, repeat rates, cost per contact
* Run dry runs of the new standard with a pilot group and refine it

**Deliver and sustain**

* Co-deliver CSE and manager workshops with the trainer
* Administer the Ready-for-floor certification test
* Run post-training mystery shopping and call audits, produce centre-wise scores and prepare packs for leadership reviews
* Coach centre managers and TLs to observe, score and coach against the standard

What you bring

**Must have**

* **10–15 years in customer service operations**
  , including all three of the following:
* **Inbound call centre:**
   managed or ran operations or quality for an inbound voice operation, ideally 50+ seats. Hands-on with call quality monitoring, AHT, first-contact resolution, CSAT and repeat-call analysis.
* **Walk-in service centres:**
   managed a network of customer service centres or branches. Knows queue and token management, counter processes, document-heavy service requests and how to manage a multi-location network.
* **Transformation projects:**
   led at least two service transformation or process improvement projects end to end. This could be SOP standardisation, a service redesign, a contact-centre turnaround, or harmonising processes after a merger, with results you can show.
* Comfortable with data: builds analyses in Excel, works with call logs and MIS, and can turn numbers into a business case
* Can run a good interview and a good workshop. Credible with a functional head and comfortable with a frontline executive.
* **Fluent in Gujarati, Hindi and English**
   (spoken; written Gujarati preferred)
* Willing to travel extensively within Gujarat

**Good to have**

* Experience in utilities, city gas distribution, power distribution, telecom, banking or insurance, meaning large regulated consumer bases with high volumes of service requests
* Familiarity with regulator-defined service standards and complaint timelines (e.g., PNGRB, state electricity regulatory commission norms)
* Lean, Six Sigma (Green Belt or above) or COPC exposure
* Experience with outsourced or agency staffing models in contact centres
* Training delivery or facilitation experience

What success looks like in the first 90 days

* A credible baseline from mystery shopping and call audits that the client’s leadership accepts
* A Gold Standard draft built from the client’s own best interactions, signed off by the client owner
* A cost-benefit case that the client’s Finance team has validated
* Strong working relationships with centre managers and call centre TLs, so that they see the program as support rather than an audit

Personal attributes

* Good at reading and getting on with people on the shop floor; earns trust quickly with frontline teams
* Rigorous with evidence: separates what they saw from what they were told
* Discreet with client data and with individual performance information
* Self-directed and able to run the program on the ground without close supervision

title: Healthcare Procurement Manager (Medical Equipment)
description:
**Category Buyer – Medical Equipment**

**Department:**
Procurement & Supply Chain (Corporate Headquarters)

**Location:**
Head Office (Corporate)

**Experience:**
~10–12 years (Mid-level)

**Reporting to:**
Head – Procurement / Supply Chain

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Position Overview / Role Purpose**

The
**Category Buyer – Medical Equipment**
is responsible for
**leading the strategic sourcing and end-to-end procurement**
of high-value medical equipment across the organization’s healthcare facilities. This mid-level role (approximately 10+ years’ experience)
**integrates clinical requirements, technical evaluation, and commercial strategy**
to ensure
**cost optimization, equipment standardization, regulatory compliance, and supply continuity**
across the healthcare network. The Category Buyer collaborates closely with cross-functional teams to align procurement plans with clinical needs and organizational growth, while driving
**digitization, sustainability, and process excellence**
.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Category Strategy & Planning:**

* **Develop and execute category strategy**
  for medical equipment procurement, aligned with business goals and expansion plans.
* **Standardize equipment specifications**
  and SKUs across hospitals to leverage scale and ensure consistency in product use.
* **Annual planning & forecasting:**
  Prepare
  **annual procurement plans**
  , consolidate demand across facilities, and support
  **CAPEX budgeting/forecasting**
  for medical equipment.
* **Market intelligence:**
  Track
  **market trends, technological advancements, and supplier innovations**
  to inform procurement decisions and support future projects.

**2. Procurement & Contract Management:**

* **End-to-end sourcing:**
  Lead the
  **full procurement lifecycle**
  – from
  **requirements gathering and tender/RFP processes to technical evaluations, negotiations, contracting, and supplier onboarding**
  .
* **Commercial negotiations:**
  Negotiate
  **favorable pricing, terms, and service-level agreements**
  for equipment purchases, including
  **annual rate contracts (ARC)**
  and long-term agreements with key vendors.
* **Contract administration:**
  Manage
  **Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC)**
  ,
  **Comprehensive Maintenance Contracts (CMC)**
  , warranties, and
  **long-term service agreements**
  , ensuring compliance with terms and maximizing equipment uptime.

**3. Financial & Cost Management:**

* **Cost optimization:**
  Drive
  **cost-saving initiatives**
  and
  **value-based procurement**
  across the medical equipment category, closely monitoring pricing benchmarks and achieving targeted
  **annual savings (e.g. 5–10% reduction in category spend)**
  .
* **Budget alignment:**
  Ensure all procurement activities align with
  **CAPEX/OPEX budgets**
  and financial strategies, maintaining fiscal discipline while meeting clinical needs.
* **Total cost of ownership:**
  Evaluate equipment purchases based on
  **lifecycle costs**
  and return on investment, balancing upfront price with long-term maintenance, operations, and disposal costs.

**4. Technical Evaluation & Compliance:**

* Coordinate
  **technical assessments of equipment**
  with clinicians, biomedical engineers, and end-users to ensure
  **equipment meets clinical requirements and specifications**
  .
* **Techno-commercial evaluations:**
  Conduct thorough
  **technical and commercial evaluations**
  of bids, comparing functionality, quality, and total cost to select
  **best-value solutions**
  .
* **Regulatory compliance:**
  Ensure all equipment and procurement processes comply with
  **healthcare regulations and quality standards**
  (e.g.,
  **NABH, JCI**
  , and local medical device regulations) and internal
  **procurement governance policies**
  .
* **Lifecycle management:**
  Oversee the
  **entire lifecycle**
  of critical equipment – from acquisition through installation, maintenance (with service contracts), and end-of-life disposal – maximizing asset utilization and ensuring continuous availability of essential equipment.

**5. Vendor & Stakeholder Management:**

* **Supplier partnerships:**
  Develop a strong
  **vendor ecosystem**
  , nurturing strategic partnerships with
  **Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) and distributors**
  to secure reliable supply and innovation support.
* **Vendor performance:**
  Implement
  **supplier scorecards**
  and track key
  **vendor performance metrics**
  (e.g., on-time-in-full delivery (OTIF), quality, service level compliance) to drive continuous improvement and accountability.
* **Collaboration:**
  Work closely with key
  **stakeholders**
  – including clinical departments, hospital administrators, finance, biomedical engineering, operations, and project teams – to align procurement decisions with operational needs and ensure seamless equipment deployment.
* **Issue resolution:**
  Address supplier issues, manage
  **supply risks**
  , and maintain
  **supply continuity**
  for critical equipment across the network.

**6. Governance, Risk & Process Excellence:**

* **Policy & SOP adherence:**
  Implement and uphold robust
  **procurement policies, SOPs**
  and
  **ethical standards**
  , ensuring transparent processes and
  **audit-ready documentation**
  .
* **Digital procurement & analytics:**
  **Drive digitization**
  of procurement through
  **e-procurement platforms**
  ,
  **spend analytics dashboards**
  , and other digital tools, improving process efficiency, spend visibility, and data-driven decision making.
* **Audit and risk management:**
  Ensure
  **audit readiness**
  ,
  **regulatory compliance**
  , and effective
  **risk mitigation**
  strategies in procurement activities to maintain the highest standards of governance and supply chain resilience.
* **Sustainable & ESG-focused procurement:**
  **Integrate sustainability and ESG (Environmental, Social, Governance) criteria**
  into procurement decisions, prioritizing ethical sourcing and environmentally responsible suppliers to support long-term organizational values and compliance.

**Key Result Areas (KRAs) & Measurable Outcomes**

**Key Result Area (KRA)**

**Measurable Outcome/Target**

**Cost Optimization**

Achieve
**5–10% annual cost savings**
in medical equipment spend through strategic sourcing, standardization, and negotiations

**Procurement Efficiency**

**Reduce procurement lead times**
and cycle times, ensuring timely delivery and commissioning of equipment to meet project schedules

**Vendor Performance & Reliability**

**Improve supplier performance metrics**
(e.g., on-time delivery > 95% OTIF, reduced stock-outs) and
**consolidate vendor base**
to enhance supply reliability

**Compliance & Governance**

**100% audit compliance**
with procurement SOPs and regulatory standards; maintain
**audit-ready documentation**
with zero major non-compliances

**Digital & Process Excellence**

**Implement e-procurement systems and analytics dashboards**
covering full category spend for improved decision support and transparency

**Stakeholder & Project Support**

**High stakeholder satisfaction**
and
**timely project support**
, enabling on-schedule commissioning of new healthcare facilities and expansions

**Key Stakeholders / Interfaces**

* **Internal:**
  Hospital CEOs/Administrators; Clinical & Nursing Leadership;
  **Biomedical Engineering**
  teams; Finance & Accounts; Project & Infrastructure teams; Hospital Operations & Supply Chain; Inventory/Stores; Quality &
  **Accreditation (e.g. NABH/NABL)**
  teams.
* **External:**
  **Suppliers/OEMs**
  , distributors, and service providers for medical equipment and maintenance.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in
  **biomedical engineering, mechanical/electrical engineering, life sciences, or supply chain management**
  ; MBA or
  **postgraduate qualification**
  in
  **Supply Chain, Operations or Healthcare Management**
  preferred.
* **Experience:**
  **10–12+ years**
  of progressive experience in
  **procurement/supply chain**
  (with significant exposure to healthcare or medical equipment sourcing). Experience in
  **hospital or healthcare group procurement**
  is strongly preferred for understanding clinical and regulatory nuances.

**Core Competencies**

* **Strategic Sourcing & Category Management:**
  Proven ability to develop and implement effective category strategies, with
  **strong negotiation and contract management skills**
  .
* **Techno-Commercial Acumen:**
  Deep understanding of
  **medical equipment technical specifications**
  , and the ability to perform
  **techno-commercial evaluations**
  and
  **lifecycle costing**
  .
* **Healthcare Regulatory & Quality Knowledge:**
  Familiarity with healthcare procurement standards and
  **regulatory requirements**
  , ensuring that equipment meets accreditation and compliance standards (e.g., NABH/JCI, medical device regulations).
* **Analytical & Financial Skills:**
  Strong
  **analytical mindset**
  with competence in
  **data-driven decision making**
  , cost analysis, and
  **budget management**
  .
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
  Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to work effectively with
  **clinical leaders, technical experts, and finance stakeholders**
  , driving alignment and consensus across departments.
* **Results Orientation & Continuous Improvement:**
  Focus on delivering measurable results (cost savings, efficiency, quality) and driving
  **continuous improvements**
  in procurement processes through best practices and innovation.

**Tools & Systems**

Proficiency with
**enterprise ERP and e-Procurement systems**
(e.g., SAP Ariba, Oracle, or similar) and
**analytics platforms**
(spend analytics,
**procurement dashboards**
) to support reporting and data-driven decision-making. Familiarity with
**digital procurement technologies**
,
**supplier management software**
, and advanced Excel/BI tools is expected as part of driving procurement digitization efforts.

MachineAstro is a fast-growing Industrial IoT platform and solutions company that puts sensors, data and AI to work on the plant floor, enabling smart manufacturing and Industry 4.0 for the most demanding manufacturing industries in the world. title: Procurement Manager
description:
**About the Role:**

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Procurement Manager to build and manage a scalable procurement portfolio that supports the company's growth, cost optimisation, technology deployments and sustainability objectives. The role will lead strategic sourcing, supplier selection, vendor relationship, inventory management, commercial negotiations and procurement governance across technology, SaaS, IoT, hardware, engineering, professional services and project-related requirements.

The Procurement Manager will work closely with Finance, Engineering, Product, Sales, Project Delivery, Operations and other stakeholders to translate business and customer requirements into cost-effective, resilient and sustainable procurement solutions. The role will combine hands-on execution with strategic supplier and category management, ensuring the right quality, value, service and delivery at the right total cost.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop and execute procurement strategies aligned with Ecolibrium's business plans, technology roadmap, customer deployments and operational requirements.
* Lead strategic sourcing activities, including supplier identification, qualification, RFIs/RFQs/RFPs, competitive evaluation, negotiations and contract award.
* Manage procurement across technology and SaaS categories, including software licences, cloud and data services, IoT devices, sensors, gateways, networking equipment, hardware and related services.
* Support project procurement for customer deployments by translating project requirements into procurement plans, budgets, sourcing activities and delivery schedules.
* Build and manage a preferred supplier ecosystem, including supplier onboarding, due diligence, performance management, reviews and continuous improvement.
* Negotiate commercial terms, pricing, payment terms, service levels, warranties, lead times and other contractual requirements to achieve best total cost of ownership.
* Work with Finance and business stakeholders on budgets, forecasts, spend analysis, savings, cost avoidance and procurement reporting.
* Establish and monitor supplier KPIs covering cost, quality, service, delivery, responsiveness and contractual performance.
* Identify and mitigate supplier, supply-chain and business-continuity risks, including critical supplier dependencies and alternative sourcing options.
* Ensure procurement activities comply with company policies, delegated authorities, approval processes and relevant legal and regulatory requirements.
* Drive procurement process improvements, standardisation, transparency and appropriate use of procurement/ERP tools and data analytics.
* Resolve supplier issues and commercial disputes promptly, escalating material risks appropriately and maintaining constructive long-term supplier relationships.
* Develop procurement dashboards and management information to provide visibility of spend, savings, supplier performance, contract status and key procurement risks.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Finance or a related field discipline.
* Proven procurement, strategic sourcing or supplier-management experience, preferably within a technology, SaaS, IoT, telecom, data-centre, engineering or other asset-intensive environment.
* Demonstrated experience in supplier sourcing, commercial negotiations, contract management, infrastructure deployment and vendor performance management.
* Strong commercial and analytical capability, with the ability to assess pricing, total cost of ownership, value and supplier performance.
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams and translating technical or business requirements into effective procurement solutions.
* Strong understanding of procurement processes, supply-chain principles, controls and governance.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, and familiarity with ERP, procurement or supplier-management systems.
* Excellent communication, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills.
* Strong attention to detail, sound judgement and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Certification in Procurement or supply chain management qualification.

description:
About Zero Degree Holidays

Zero Degree Holidays is a travel company specializing in 
**customized domestic and international travel experiences**
. We work with couples, families, business travellers and corporate clients to create personalized holidays based on their requirements, preferences and budget.

We are looking for a 
**Travel Consultant**
 to join our growing team in Ahmedabad.

About the Role

As a Travel Consultant, you will be responsible for handling travel inquiries from the initial conversation through quotation, follow-up and booking. You will understand the customer's requirements, recommend suitable travel options, coordinate with suppliers and help convert inquiries into confirmed bookings.

This is a 
**customer-facing sales role**
, ideal for someone who enjoys travel, communication and building relationships with customers.

Key Responsibilities

* Handle incoming travel inquiries through WhatsApp, phone calls and other channels.
* Understand customer requirements including destination, travel dates, number of travellers, budget, hotel preferences and activities.
* Recommend suitable destinations, hotels, itineraries and travel options.
* Prepare customized travel quotations based on customer requirements.
* Coordinate with hotels, DMCs, transport providers and other suppliers to obtain rates and availability.
* Follow up with customers after quotations and work towards converting inquiries into bookings.
* Handle customer questions and basic objections professionally.
* Maintain accurate inquiry, quotation and follow-up records.
* Coordinate with the operations team once a booking is confirmed.
* Stay updated about destinations, hotels, travel products and current travel trends.
* Build strong and long-term relationships with customers.

What We're Looking For

* 1–3 years of experience in travel, tourism, sales, customer service or a related field is preferred.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good spoken and written English.
* Hindi and Gujarati communication skills will be an advantage.
* Good knowledge of WhatsApp, email and basic computer applications.
* Strong follow-up and organizational skills.
* Customer-focused attitude with a genuine interest in travel.
* Ability to understand customer needs and recommend suitable solutions.
* Sales-oriented mindset and willingness to achieve targets.
* Good attention to detail.

Preferred / Added Advantage

* Previous experience with a travel agency, tour operator or DMC.
* Knowledge of domestic and international destinations.
* Experience preparing travel quotations.
* Experience coordinating with hotels and travel suppliers.
* Knowledge of visa processes, flights or travel documentation.
* Experience using CRM, Google Sheets or similar tools.

What You Can Expect

* Opportunity to work with a growing travel company.
* Exposure to both domestic and international travel.
* Hands-on experience in travel consultation, sales and destination planning.
* Opportunity to develop strong destination and travel-industry knowledge.
* A role with genuine growth potential as the company expands.
* **If you love travel, enjoy talking to people and have a passion for turning travel ideas into real holidays, we'd love to hear from you.**

title: Patient Journey Partner- Neurology
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
**Patient Journey Partner- Neurology**
**Location: All Locations**
**The Position**
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
  
  
We are seeking candidates to join our team as Patient Journey Partner In this role, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on patient care by connecting Roche’s capabilities and resources to co-create solutions with key stakeholders involved in the patient journey. Your role is multifaceted, addressing diverse patient journey needs such as accelerating access to treatments, streamlining decision making. This role is locally embedded in the ecosystem, it is an integrated role, functionally agnostic, (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs). The PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.
  
  
**Your Opportunity**

* You will be responsible for end to end management of Top Therapy Area Expert relations and legitimate needs through right identification of challenges, belief, motivators
* You will be a one point of contact for top accounts of the state. You will be creating and executing strategies for the top public & private accounts, aligning with and support state teams for effective execution of the state strategies, so as to serve and maximize patients with Roche Innovations
* You will be building relationship with key decision makers in the account Identifying and resolving business issues in top accounts and Implement strategies and drive results for enhancing access to Roche innovations
* You will be leading collaboration in field through co-creation of solutions for key accounts

**Who You Are**

* You are someone who has a relevant graduate/ post graduate degree in Science. From an experience standpoint having more than 8 years’ experience with 4+ years in Neurology
* You must exhibit strong collaboration and networking skills, process orientation and alliance management

Who we are
  
  
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
  
  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
  
  
**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

title: Specialist Bridges
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
We are seeking an accomplished
**Specialist Bridges**
to drive the domestic delivery and support strategic growth within our Transport Structures team. This senior role is central to strengthening our position in India’s bridge market—especially in complex projects, major infrastructure bids, and capture management for priority pursuits.
  
  
You will play a key role in steering high‑quality technical outputs, leading teams on complex structures, and shaping winning strategies for major tenders. With deep structural background and proven leadership across design and bidding cycles, you will help elevate our technical excellence, expand client relationships, and support the successful delivery of iconic design and build bridge projects across India and overseas. In this role you will provide
  
  
**Technical Leadership**

* Direct and manage design for long‑span bridges, complex structures, and other transportation structures in multi-disciplinary infrastructure projects
* Provide technical direction, guidance, and mentorship to junior engineers and cross-functional project teams.
* Responsible for managing quality assurance in project delivery, complying to Jacobs Quality Management systems.
* Support clients in technical decision-making, providing opening and middle game support in strategic pursuits, providing robust engineering solutions.

**Project Delivery**

* Oversee design schedule, resources, budget, and deliverables to ensure timely and high‑quality outcomes, keeping our clients delighted.
* Coordinate effectively with clients, contractors, consultants, internal teams and all other relevant stakeholders throughout all design stages.

**Bidding & Capture Management**

* Drive the preparation of technical proposals, scope of Works, resource plans, and financial estimates for domestic infrastructure bids, benchmarking with the market standards and requirements.
* Partner closely with business development teams to shape winning strategies for major pursuits
* Lead capture planning efforts for long‑span bridges/major crossings, and transport structure opportunities

**Quality & Compliance**

* Ensure adherence to organizational quality standards, industry regulations, and statutory requirements.
* Conduct technical reviews, risk assessments, and ensure appropriate mitigation strategies are implemented.

**Client & Market Engagement**

* Build and nurture relationships with key clients, government agencies, and major industry partners.
* Stay connected to the domestic infrastructure market to identify early opportunities and support pursuit strategies.
* Represent the organization at technical forums, client meetings, and industry events.

Here's what you'll need
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Civil Engineering (Structures specialization preferred).
* Minimum of 15 years of experience in bridge design and projecy delivery.
* Extensive background in domestic infrastructure projects, including highways, railways, and urban development. Having exposure to international clients will be preferred.
* Proven experience preparing proposals and bids for government and private sector clients in domestic market.
* Proficiency in structural analysis and design software such as STAAD Pro, MIDAS, etc.
* Comprehensive knowledge of IRC, IRS, IS codes, and MoRTH specifications. Exposure to international standards like AASHTO and Eurocodes will be preferred.
* Excellent communication and leadership skills.
* Ability to work in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
  
  
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

title: Integration Analyst
description:
Cin7 is a fast-growing global software company that provides solutions for modern-day product sellers. We help these sellers keep track of their inventory at scale, and help them sell their products across multiple sales channels around the world.
  
  
Cin7 is expanding very quickly with a mission to become the leading Inventory Management Software brand in the world, and we are looking for a motivated and driven individual to join the team.
  
  
Cin7 India is proud of our culture and has been officially recognised with Great Place to Work® Certification™.
  
  
**How You'll Make An Impact**
As an Integration Analyst, you own, lead and deliver EDI and 3PL integrations between Cin7 customers and external trading partners. You provide technical support to the Cin7 client base, resolving technical issues and determining the client’s service and support needs.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Ownership & Time Management**
Accelerates connection lifecycles toward successful completion through expert troubleshooting and debugging. Proactively manages dependencies for all assigned tasks while participating in requirement analysis and necessary exploratory research. Demonstrates the capability to isolate technical discrepancies to identify fundamental root causes.
  
  
Assumes full accountability for delivering small to medium-complexity projects, adapting functional strategies independently or within a team to secure optimal results.
  
  
**Technical & Product knowledge**
Possesses a comprehensive understanding of EDI architecture and proficiency in the requisite tooling for connection development. Skilled in executing testing protocols to diagnose reproducible defects and propose technical resolutions. Confidently manages compliance validation across diverse retail and trading partner landscapes. Enhances collective team expertise through domain knowledge sharing, supported by a firm grasp of EDI, 3PL, and API integration workflows and bug remediation.
  
  
**Customer Engagement & Escalations**
Maintains proactive, solution-oriented dialogue with clients, ensuring expectations are managed with transparency. Coordinates with leadership to influence outcomes when necessary and provides clear communication regarding functional limitations and feasible paths for issue resolution.
  
  
**Drives Results**
Reliably achieves established monthly and quarterly performance metrics, pursuing ambitious stretch targets to consistently surpass client expectations.
  
  
**Team Work**
Operates with high autonomy, selecting workstreams that align with organizational objectives. Actively participates in collaborative forums to exchange ideas and contributes to the maintenance of critical team documentation.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement**
Evaluates the broader implications of design choices and proposes enhanced alternatives. Cultivates a growth mindset while playing a central role in refining team methodologies and operational practices to increase scalability and efficiency.
  
  
**What You'll Bring**

* Tertiary education with a relevant degree
* 3+ years in a client-facing role, strong understanding of relevant technologies and platforms (supply chain, inventory management, EDI/3PL) and sufficient technical knowledge in SQL, HTML, CSS, and web-based applications.
* Strong technical problem solving skills and complex understanding of customer pain points
* Deep domain knowledge
* Excellent customer service skills with consistent follow-up and the ability to handle customer requests and issues independently. Seeks feedback to improve service delivery.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple connections or projects simultaneously, especially for medium- to large-sized customers.
* Proven track record of delivering exceptional customer service with strong feedback and reviews.
* Change Management skills and the ability to identify and implement process improvements to enhance the efficiency and scalability of EDI/3PL connections.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, and conflict resolution skills, with the ability to manage and realign escalated connections.
* Demonstrated ownership skills

**Why work for us?**

* We are a fast growing business going through a huge amount of growth.
* You’ll have the opportunity to work on products that are used by our global customer-base and at the same time you’ll be growing your career and developing new skills.
* Hybrid work environment
* Work From Anywhere for 30 days in a six month period
* Celebrate your birthday with a paid day off
* A Global Cin7 Day celebrated companywide, providing you a dedicated holiday to focus on your own wellbeing.
* Recruitment referral bonus
* Work for a Great Place to Work®

₹12,00,000 - ₹14,00,000 a year
  
  
**Why CIN7?**
CIN7 is a leader in one of the most exciting software verticals right now, and we're growing exponentially. We're looking to add people to our team who are passionate about working with a fast growth tech company.
  
  
At CIN7, we make great products available to everyone. Every month, millions of sales orders flow through our platform reducing the cost, effort and time for product sellers so they can quickly get products to customers and build their brands without worrying about their operations. We pride ourselves on providing Inventory Management and Supply Chain software to help medium-large product businesses thrive in a highly competitive, digital world. CIN7 centrally manages inventory across multiple locations and channels, connecting 500+ systems to support receiving, selling and shipping stock.
  
  
***We value diversity at Cin7, and bring people into the heart of everything we do. We hire, recruit, and promote without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, pregnancy or maternity, veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law. We understand the importance of creating a safe and comfortable work environment and encourage individualism and authenticity in every member of our team.***
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

description:
**Company Description** 
 The Concrete Shop® is a curated platform that showcases design\-led concrete products and architectural elements for architects, designers, and creators. The company unites premium concrete products and specialized brands, enabling users to explore concrete’s full potential as an architectural material. Its work is driven by advanced precast technologies such as FRC, GRC, SFRC, PFRC, UHPC, and decorative and pigmented concrete, allowing for strong, precise, and flexible design outcomes. With a portfolio of more than 2,500 products spanning furniture, planters, lighting, landscape elements, and architectural components, The Concrete Shop® is built on continuous experimentation with material, form, and engineering. The team views concrete as a medium for purposeful design that shapes environments, objects, and everyday experiences.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Franchise Development Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Ahmedabad. This role involves identifying and qualifying prospective franchise partners, managing lead generation activities, and guiding candidates through the franchise evaluation and onboarding process. The Franchise Development Manager will develop and present franchise business plans, collaborate on territory and expansion strategies, and maintain relationships with existing franchisees to support their growth and performance. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include conducting discovery meetings, preparing franchise proposals, coordinating training for new franchise partners, and working closely with internal teams to ensure brand and operational standards are consistently met. The role also includes tracking sales metrics, reporting on pipeline status, and contributing insights to refine the overall franchise strategy.
 



**Qualifications**

title: Territory Business Associate
description:
**About Aipri Lifesciences LLP** 




 Established in 2025 and headquartered in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, Aipri Lifesciences is an emerging, fast\-growing medical device company dedicated to delivering high\-quality surgical solutions. Founded and led by a medical doctor with extensive cross\-functional experience in clinical research and pharma medical affairs, Aipri bridges the gap between clinical necessity and technical excellence.
 



  





**What We Do** 




 We specialize in the technical design, material specification, and commercialization of premium surgical consumables, including advanced braided sutures (like Aicryl Polyglactin 910\) and surgical skin glue. Driven by a commitment to superior patient outcomes, we are aggressively expanding our product portfolio into a wider array of advanced medical instruments and devices.
 



  





**Our Vision \& Culture** 




 Our vision is to build Aipri into a highly respected, successful brand with a global reach. We are grounded in the core values of honesty, humility, intelligence, and kindness. At Aipri, we maintain a positive, realistic, and dependable work environment that respects the balance between ambitious business growth and personal peace of mind.
 



  





**Why Join Us?** 




 Working at Aipri means joining a forward\-thinking, doctor\-led enterprise where your contributions directly impact the healthcare ecosystem. We offer structured compensation models, a clear strategic roadmap, and a collaborative environment where disciplined, dependable, and intellectually driven professionals can thrive and build a meaningful career.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Operation Theater (OT) Engagement:** 
 Spend active time in hospital OT environments, supporting surgeons and OT teams during product evaluation to build clinical confidence in Aipri’s suture portfolio.



  




* **Surgeon \& Specialty Coverage:** 
 Build and maintain direct relationships with key surgeons across multiple specialties (General Surgery, OB\-GYN, Orthopedics).



  




* **Territory \& Account Management:** 
 Map private hospitals, nursing homes, and day\-care surgical centers in assigned Ahmedabad clusters; identify new accounts and drive repeat orders.



  




* **Institutional \& Purchase Coordination:** 
 Engage Hospital Purchase Managers, Procurement Teams, and OT Sisters\-in\-Charge to facilitate product code listings, vendor registration, and seamless ordering.



  




* **Supply \& Delivery Support:** 
 Coordinate with the internal operations team to ensure direct, next\-day product delivery to hospital clients and manage local inventory needs.



  




* **Market \& Competitor Intelligence:** 
 Track local surgeon preference shifts, competitor activity, and hospital procurement dynamics, reporting field insights directly to leadership.



  





**Candidate Profile \& Requirements** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy (B.Pharm / M.Pharm), Biotechnology, or related fields.
* 1 to 3 years in Surgical Devices, Medical Consumables, OT Products, or Clinical Hospital Sales in Ahmedabad.
* Fully comfortable working within the Operation Theater (OT) environment and interacting directly with surgical teams.
* Existing contacts with surgeons, OT staff, and hospital purchase departments across key Ahmedabad surgical clusters.
* Strong scientific learning aptitude, relationship\-building skills, commercial negotiation ability, and high integrity.
* Must own a two\-wheeler with a valid driving license for daily local territory coverage.



  





**Field Working Structure \& Culture** 



* Working Days: Monday to Saturday.
* Field Timings: Aligned with surgeon availability and OT schedules (starts at 9:30 AM; flexible field wrap\-up based on daily doctor appointments and hospital rounds).
* Compensation: Competitive fixed salary (commensurate with experience) \+ Daily Local Conveyance Allowance (TA/DA) \+ Incentives.
